卷三百二十七 列傳第二百十五 外國八 韃靼

1
韃靼，即蒙古，故元後也。 太祖洪武元年，大將軍徐達率師取元，元主自北平遁出塞，居開平，數遣其將也速等擾北邊。 明年，常遇春擊敗之，師進開平，俘宗王慶孫、平章鼎住。
The Tartars were the Mongols—the surviving remnant of the Yuan dynasty. In the first year of Hongwu, the Hongwu Emperor dispatched the great general Xu Da to conquer the Yuan. The Yuan emperor fled Beiping for the lands beyond the frontier and made his seat at Kaiping, from which he repeatedly sent generals such as Yesu to raid the northern border. The following year Chang Yuchun routed the Yuan forces and pressed on to Kaiping, where he took captive the imperial prince Qingsun and the minister Dingzhu.
2
時元主奔應昌，其將王保保據定西為邊患。 三年春，以徐達為大將軍，使出西安搗定西； 李文忠為左副將軍，馮勝為右副將軍，使出居庸搗應昌。 文忠至興和，擒平章竹貞，復大破元兵於駱駝山，遂趨應昌。 未至，知元主已殂，進圍其城，克之。 獲元主孫買的裡八剌及其妃嬪、大臣、寶玉、圖籍。 太子愛猷識理達臘獨以數十騎遁去。 而徐達亦大破王保保兵於沈兒峪口，走之。 太祖封買的裡八剌為崇禮侯，謚元主曰順帝。 於是故元諸將江文清等、王子失篤兒等，先後歸附。 獨王保保擁太子愛猷識理達臘居和林，屢詔諭之，不從。
By then the Yuan emperor had fled to Yingchang, while his general Wang Baobao held Dingxi and became a persistent threat along the frontier. In the spring of the third year Xu Da was appointed great general and ordered to march from Xi'an against Dingxi; Li Wenzhong was named left deputy general and Feng Sheng right deputy general, with orders to advance through Juyong Pass and strike at Yingchang. Wenzhong reached Xinghe, captured the minister Zhuzhen, won a great victory over Yuan forces at Camel Mountain, and pressed on toward Yingchang. Before he arrived he learned that the Yuan emperor was already dead. He advanced, besieged the city, and took it. Among the spoils were the Yuan emperor's grandson Maidiribala, the imperial consorts, court ministers, precious jades, and the dynastic archives. Only the crown prince Ayushiridara escaped, fleeing with a few dozen horsemen. Meanwhile Xu Da won a crushing victory over Wang Baobao's army at Shen'er Pass and drove him from the field. The Hongwu Emperor enfeoffed Maidiribala as Marquis Chongli and granted the Yuan emperor the posthumous title Emperor Shun. After this, former Yuan generals such as Jiang Wenqing and princes such as Shidur submitted to the Ming one after another. Only Wang Baobao, holding the crown prince Ayushiridara at Karakorum, defied repeated imperial edicts and refused to submit.
3
五年春，命大將軍徐達、左副將軍李文忠、征西將軍馮勝率師三道征之。 大將軍達由中路出雁門，戰不利，守塞。 勝軍西次蘭州。 右副將軍傅友德先進，轉戰至埽林山，勝等兵合，斬其平章不花，降上都驢等所部吏民八千三百餘戶，遂由亦集乃路至瓜、沙州，復連敗之。 文忠東出居庸至口溫，元將棄營遁，乃率輕騎自臚朐河疾馳，進敗蠻子哈剌章於土剌河，追及阿魯渾河，又追及稱海，獲其官屬子孫並軍士家屬千八百餘，送京師。 達等尋召還。 明年春，遣達、文忠等備西北邊。 元兵入犯武、朔，達遣陳德、郭子興擊破之。 未幾，達等復大破王保保兵於懷柔。 時元兵先後犯白登、保德、河曲，輒為守將所敗，獨撫寧、瑞州被殘，太祖乃徙其民於內地。
In the spring of the fifth year the court ordered the great general Xu Da, left deputy general Li Wenzhong, and western campaign general Feng Sheng to march against them in three columns. The great general Xu Da marched by the central route through Yanmen Pass, fought without success, and held the frontier defenses. Feng Sheng's army encamped in the west at Lanzhou. Right deputy general Fu Youde led the advance, fighting his way to Saolin Mountain, where Feng Sheng joined him. They beheaded the minister Buhua and accepted the surrender of more than eight thousand three hundred households under Shangdu Lu and his followers. Then, marching by way of Ejin to Guazhou and Shazhou, they won victory after victory. Wenzhong marched east from Juyong Pass to Kouwen, where the Yuan generals abandoned their camp and fled. He then led light cavalry in a swift dash from the Luqu River, routed Manzi Halazhang on the Tula River, pursued the enemy to the Arun River and then to Chenghai, and captured more than eighteen hundred officials, their kin, and soldiers' families, whom he sent to the capital. Xu Da and the other commanders were soon recalled. The following spring Xu Da, Wenzhong, and others were dispatched to guard the northwestern frontier. When Yuan forces invaded Wu and Shuo, Xu Da sent Chen De and Guo Zixing to repulse them. Before long Xu Da and his colleagues won another great victory over Wang Baobao's army at Huairou. Yuan raids against Baideng, Baode, and Hequ were beaten back one after another, but Funing and Ruizhou were devastated. The Hongwu Emperor therefore relocated their people to safer lands within the interior.
4
七年夏，都督藍玉拔興和。 文忠亦遣裨將擒斬其長，而自以大軍攻高州大石崖，克之，斬宗王、大臣朵朵失裡等，至氈帽山斬魯王，獲其妃蒙哥禿。 秋，太祖以故元太子流離沙漠，父子隔絕，未有後嗣，乃遣崇禮侯北歸，以書諭之。 又二年，其部下九住等寇西邊，敗去。
In the summer of the seventh year the commander Lan Yu took Xinghe. Wenzhong sent a subordinate general to capture and behead an enemy chieftain, while he himself led the main army against the Great Stone Cliff of Gaozhou and took it. There he executed the imperial prince Duoduoshili and other ministers, then pressed on to Zhanmao Mountain, where he killed the Prince of Lu and captured his consort Menggutu. That autumn, moved by the plight of the former Yuan crown prince—exiled in the desert, cut off from his father, and without an heir—the Hongwu Emperor sent the Marquis Chongli back north with a letter of admonition. Two years later his followers Jiuzhu and others raided the western frontier, were defeated, and withdrew.
5
洪武十一年夏，故元太子愛猷識理達臘卒，太祖自為文，遣使弔祭。 子脫古思帖木兒繼立。 其丞相驢兒、蠻子哈剌章，國公脫火赤，平章完者不花、乃兒不花，樞密知院愛足等，擁眾於應昌、和林，時出沒塞下。 太祖屢賜璽書諭之，不從。 十三年春，西平侯沐英師出靈州，渡黃河，歷賀蘭山，踐流沙，擒脫火赤、愛足等於和林，盡以其部曲歸。 冬，完者不花亦就擒。 明年春，徐達及副將軍湯和、傅友德征乃兒不花，至河北，襲灰山，斬獲甚眾。
In the summer of the eleventh year of Hongwu the former Yuan crown prince Ayushiridara died. The Hongwu Emperor composed the eulogy himself and sent envoys to mourn and sacrifice on his behalf. His son Toghus Temür succeeded him. Their chancellor Lu'er, Manzi Halazhang, the state duke Tuohuochi, the ministers Wanzhebuhua and Na'erbuhua, the Privy Council vice-director Aizu, and others gathered forces at Yingchang and Karakorum, raiding back and forth along the frontier. The Hongwu Emperor repeatedly sent sealed edicts urging submission, but they refused to heed him. In the spring of the thirteenth year the Marquis of Xiping Mu Ying marched from Lingzhou, crossed the Yellow River, crossed Helan Mountain and the drifting sands, captured Tuohuochi, Aizu, and others at Karakorum, and brought all their followers back with him. That winter Wanzhebuhua was captured as well. The following spring Xu Da, with deputy generals Tang He and Fu Youde, marched against Na'erbuhua, reached Hebei, struck Huishan Mountain, and killed or captured a great many of the enemy.
6
時王保保已先卒，諸巨魁多以次平定，或望風歸附，獨丞相納哈出擁二十萬眾據金山，數窺伺遼。 二十年春，命宋國公馮勝為大將軍，率潁川侯傅友德、永昌侯藍玉等，將兵二十萬征之，還其先所獲元將乃剌吾。 勝軍駐通州，遣藍玉乘大雪襲慶州，克之。 夏，師逾金山，臨江侯陳鏞失道，陷敵死。 乃剌吾歸，備以朝廷撫卹恩語其眾，於是全國公觀童來降。 納哈出因聞乃剌吾之言已心悸，復為大軍所迫，乃陽使人至大將軍營納款，以覘兵勢。 勝遣玉往受降。 使者見勝軍還報，納哈出仰天嘆曰：「天弗使吾有此眾矣。 」遂率數百騎詣玉納降。 已，將脫去，為鄭國公常茂所傷不得去。 都督耿忠遂以眾擁之見勝，勝重禮之，使忠與同寢食。 先後降其部曲二十餘萬人，及聞納哈出傷，由是驚潰者四萬人，獲輜重畜馬亙百餘里。 勝班師，都督濮英以三千騎殿，為潰卒所邀襲，死之。 秋，勝等表上納哈出所部官屬二百餘人，將校三千三百餘人，金銀銅印一百顆，虎符牌面百二十五事，馬二百九十餘匹，稱賀。 太祖封納哈出為海西侯，先後賜予甚厚，並授乃剌吾千戶。
By then Wang Baobao was already dead, and most of the great chieftains had been subdued in turn or submitted at the first sight of Ming banners. Only Chancellor Nahachu, holding two hundred thousand men at Jinshan, repeatedly watched for a chance to strike into Liaodong. In the spring of the twentieth year Feng Sheng, Duke of Song, was appointed great general. At the head of two hundred thousand men—including Fu Youde, Marquis of Yingchuan, and Lan Yu, Marquis of Yongchang—he marched against Nahachu, bringing with him the former Yuan general Nalaiwu, whom the Ming had captured earlier and now returned. Feng Sheng encamped at Tongzhou and sent Lan Yu to exploit a heavy snowfall and storm Qingzhou, which fell. That summer the army crossed Jinshan. Chen Yong, Marquis of Linjiang, lost his way, was cut off by the enemy, and killed. When Nalaiwu returned, he told his followers of the court's benevolent treatment, and the state duke Guantong came over to the Ming. Nahachu, shaken by Nalaiwu's report and hard pressed by the main army, feigned submission, sending envoys to the great general's camp to offer allegiance while spying on Ming strength. Feng Sheng sent Lan Yu to receive the surrender. When his envoys saw Feng Sheng's army and returned to report, Nahachu looked up to heaven and sighed: "Heaven will not let me keep this host." He then rode with several hundred men to Lan Yu and submitted. Soon afterward, as he tried to slip away, Chang Mao, Duke of Zheng, wounded him and prevented his escape. Commander Geng Zhong then escorted him before Feng Sheng, who received him with great courtesy and had Zhong share his meals and lodging. More than two hundred thousand of his followers submitted in the course of the campaign. When word spread that Nahachu had been wounded, another forty thousand panicked and fled, abandoning baggage, livestock, and horses that stretched along the road for more than a hundred li. As Feng Sheng withdrew, Commander Pu Ying, covering the retreat with three thousand horsemen, was ambushed by fleeing soldiers and killed. That autumn Feng Sheng and his colleagues memorialized the capture of more than two hundred officials from Nahachu's following, more than three thousand three hundred officers, one hundred gold, silver, and bronze seals, one hundred twenty-five tiger tallies and command plaques, and more than two hundred ninety horses, offering congratulations on the victory. The Hongwu Emperor enfeoffed Nahachu as Marquis of Haixi, lavished rewards upon him, and granted Nalaiwu the rank of chiliarch.
7
納哈出既降，帝以故元遺寇終為邊患，乃即軍中拜藍玉為大將軍，唐勝、郭英副之，耿忠、孫恪為左、右參將，率師十五萬往征之。 冬，元將脫脫等降於玉。 明年春，玉以大軍由大寧至慶州，聞脫古思帖木兒在捕魚兒海，從間道馳進，至百眼井哨不見敵，欲引還。 定遠侯王弼曰：「吾等奉聖主威德，提十萬餘眾，深入至此，無所得，何以覆命？ 」玉乃穴地而爨，一夜馳至捕魚兒海。 黎明，去敵營八十里。 時大風揚沙，晝晦，軍行無知者，敵不設備。 弼為前鋒，直薄之，遂大破其軍，斬太尉、蠻子數千人。 脫古思帖木兒以其太子天保奴、知院捏怯來、丞相失烈門等數十騎遁去，獲其次子地保奴及妃主五十餘人、渠率三千、男女七萬餘，馬駝牛羊十萬，聚鎧仗焚之。 又破其將哈剌章營，盡降其眾。 於是漠北削平。 捷奏至，太祖大悅，賜地保奴等鈔幣，命有司給供具。 既有言玉私元主妃者，帝怒，妃慚懼自殺。 地保奴出怨言，帝居之琉球。
Once Nahachu had submitted, the emperor—fearing that remnant Yuan bands would remain a lasting frontier menace—promoted Lan Yu to great general on the spot, with Tang Sheng and Guo Ying as deputies and Geng Zhong and Sun Ke as left and right staff generals, and sent them north with one hundred fifty thousand men. That winter the Yuan generals Tuotuo and others submitted to Lan Yu. The following spring Lan Yu led the main army from Daning to Qingzhou. Hearing that Toghus Temür was encamped at Buyur Lake, he hurried along a hidden route. When he reached the Baiyanjing outpost and still saw no enemy, he wished to turn back. The Marquis of Dingyuan, Wang Bi, said: "We march under the Son of Heaven's majesty at the head of more than one hundred thousand men. Having come this deep into enemy country, how can we return empty-handed?" Lan Yu then dug cooking pits in the earth and, in a single night, galloped on to Buyur Lake. At dawn they were eighty li from the enemy camp. A great wind whipped up the sand and blotted out the daylight. The army advanced unseen, and the enemy stood unprepared. Wang Bi led the vanguard and struck straight at the enemy camp. The Yuan army was shattered, and the Grand Preceptor Manzi and several thousand others were beheaded. Toghus Temür fled with his crown prince Tianbaonu, the vice-director Nieqilai, the chancellor Shiliemen, and a few dozen horsemen. The Ming captured his second son Dibaonu, more than fifty consorts and princesses, three thousand chieftains, more than seventy thousand men and women, and one hundred thousand horses, camels, cattle, and sheep; they piled up the captured armor and weapons and burned them. They then broke the camp of his general Halazhang and accepted the surrender of all his followers. With that, the northern desert was brought to heel. When news of the victory arrived, the Hongwu Emperor was greatly pleased. He bestowed paper money on Dibaonu and the others and ordered the relevant offices to provide for them. When word came that Lan Yu had privately taken a consort of the Yuan emperor, the emperor flew into a rage. The consort, shamed and terrified, took her own life. Dibaonu spoke resentfully, and the emperor had him settled in Ryukyu.
8
脫古思帖木兒既遁，將依丞相咬住於和林，行至土剌河，為其下也速迭兒所襲，眾復散，獨與捏怯來等十六騎偕。 適咬住來迎，欲共往依闊闊帖木兒，大雪不得發。 也速迭兒兵猝至，縊殺之，並殺天保奴。 於是捏怯來、失烈門等來降，置之全寧衛。 未幾，捏怯來為失烈門所襲殺，眾潰，詔朵顏等衛招撫之，來降者益眾。 二十三年春，命潁國公傅友德等以北平兵從燕王，定遠侯王弼等以山西兵從晉王，征咬住及乃兒不花、阿魯帖木兒等。 燕王出古北口，偵知乃兒不花營迤都，冒大雪馳進，去敵一磧，敵不知也。 先遣指揮觀童往，觀童舊與乃兒不花善，一見相持泣。 頃之，大軍壓其營，乃兒不花驚，欲遁，觀童止之，引見王，賜飲食慰諭遣還。 乃兒不花喜過望，遂偕咬住等來降。 久之，乃兒不花等以謀叛誅死，敵益衰。 太祖亦封燕、晉諸王為邊籓鎮，更歲遣大將巡行塞下，督諸衛卒屯田，戒以持重，寇來輒敗之。 而敵自脫古思帖木兒後，部帥紛拏，五傳至坤帖木兒，咸被弒，不復知帝號。 有鬼力赤者篡立，稱可汗，去國號，遂稱韃靼雲。
After his flight Toghus Temür meant to take refuge with Chancellor Yaoqia at Karakorum. On the Tula River his subordinate Yesudier attacked him; his followers scattered again, and only Nieqilai and sixteen horsemen remained at his side. Yaoqia came out to meet him, and they planned to seek refuge with Kuokuotemür, but heavy snow kept them from marching. Yesudier's troops suddenly arrived, strangled Toghus Temür to death, and killed Tianbaonu as well. Nieqilai, Shiliemen, and others then submitted and were settled in the Quanning Guard. Before long Nieqilai was attacked and killed by Shiliemen, and the host broke apart. The court ordered the Duoyan Guard and others to win over the fugitives, and ever more came over to the Ming. In the spring of the twenty-third year Fu Youde, Duke of Ying, was ordered to lead Beiping troops with the Prince of Yan, and Wang Bi, Marquis of Dingyuan, to lead Shanxi troops with the Prince of Jin, in a campaign against Yaoqia, Na'erbuhua, Aru Timur, and others. The Prince of Yan marched out through Gubeikou. Scouts reported Na'erbuhua's camp at Yidu. He pressed forward through driving snow and, when still one stretch of desert from the enemy, remained undetected. He first sent Commander Guan Tong ahead. Guan Tong had once been on good terms with Na'erbuhua, and when they met the two embraced and wept. Before long the main army closed on the camp. Na'erbuhua, startled, tried to flee, but Guan Tong restrained him and brought him before the prince, who feasted him, reassured him, and sent him back. Na'erbuhua, delighted beyond all expectation, then came to submit together with Yaoqia and the others. In time Na'erbuhua and his companions were executed for plotting rebellion, and Yuan power on the steppe waned further. The Hongwu Emperor also enfeoffed the princes of Yan and Jin as frontier lords, sent great generals each year to patrol the northern defenses, supervised garrison troops in frontier farming, and enjoined them to stand firm—whenever raiders came, to beat them back. After Toghus Temür the tribal chiefs fell into turmoil. Five rulers succeeded one another down to Kuntemür; each was assassinated, and the steppe no longer even preserved the imperial title. One Güilüchi seized power, proclaimed himself khan, cast off the dynastic name, and thereafter styled the realm Tartar Cloud.
9
永樂三年，頭目埽胡兒、察罕達魯花等先後來歸。 久之，阿魯台殺鬼力赤，而迎元之後本雅失裡於別失八里，立為可汗。
In the third year of Yongle the chieftains Saohu'er, Chahandaulihua, and others came over to the Ming one after another. In time Arughtai killed Güilüchi and, at Beshbalik, enthroned Buyanshir, a descendant of the Yuan, as khan.
10
六年春，帝即以書諭本雅失裡曰：「自元運既訖，順帝后愛猷識理達臘至坤帖木兒凡六傳，瞬息之間，未聞一人善終者。 我皇考太祖高皇帝於元氏子孫，加意撫恤，來歸者輒令北還，如遣脫古思帖木兒歸，嗣為可汗，此南北人所共知。 朕之心即皇考之心。 茲元氏宗祧不絕如線，去就之機，禍福由分，爾宜審處之。 」不聽。
In the spring of the sixth year the emperor wrote to Buyanshir: "Since the Yuan dynasty's fortune ran out, from Ayushiridara, consort of Emperor Shun, down to Kuntemür there have been six successions—and in that brief span not one is said to have died in his bed." "Our imperial father, the Hongwu Emperor, showed deliberate kindness to the Yuan imperial line: whenever one of them submitted, he sent him back north—as when he restored Toghus Temür as khan. North and south alike know this." "My heart is my father's heart." "Now the Yuan ancestral line hangs by a thread. Whether you stay or go, and whether fortune or ruin follows, is for you to decide—you must weigh it carefully." Buyanshir would not listen.
11
明年，獲其部曲完者帖木兒等二十二人，帝因復使給事中郭驥齎書往。 驥被殺，帝怒。 秋，命淇國公丘福為大將軍，武城侯王聰、同安侯火真副之，靖安侯王忠、安平侯李遠為左、右參將，將精騎十萬北討，諭以毋失機，毋輕犯敵，一舉未捷，俟再舉。 時本雅失裡已為瓦剌所襲破，與阿魯台徙居臚朐河。 福率千騎先馳，遇游兵擊破之。 軍未集，福乘勝渡河追敵，敵輒佯敗引去。 諸將以帝命止福，福不聽。 敵眾奄至，圍之，五將軍皆沒。 帝益怒。
The following year the Ming captured twenty-two of his followers, including Wanzhetemür, and the emperor again dispatched Supervising Secretary Guo Ji with a letter. Guo Ji was killed, and the emperor was enraged. That autumn he appointed Qiu Fu, Duke of Qi, great general, with Wang Cong, Marquis of Wucheng, and Huo Zhen, Marquis of Tong'an, as deputies, and Wang Zhong, Marquis of Jing'an, and Li Yuan, Marquis of Anping, as left and right staff generals. With one hundred thousand elite horsemen they marched north to punish the Tartars, under strict orders not to miss their chance, not to provoke the enemy rashly, and if the first blow failed, to wait and strike again. By then Buyanshir had already been routed by the Oirats and, with Arughtai, had withdrawn to the Luqu River. Qiu Fu galloped ahead with one thousand horsemen, met enemy scouts, and routed them. Before the main army had assembled, Qiu Fu, emboldened by the victory, crossed the river in pursuit while the enemy repeatedly feigned defeat and drew him on. The other generals, citing the emperor's orders, tried to stop him, but Qiu Fu would not listen. The enemy host suddenly closed in and surrounded them; all five generals perished. The emperor's rage only deepened.
12
明年，帝自將五十萬眾出塞。 本雅失裡聞之懼，欲與阿魯台俱西，阿魯台不從，眾潰散，君臣始各為部。 本雅失裡西奔，阿魯台東奔。 帝追及斡難河，本雅失裡拒戰。 帝麾兵奮擊，一呼敗之。 本雅失裡棄輜重孳畜，以七騎遁。 斡難河者，元太祖始興地也。 班師至靜虜鎮，遇阿魯台，帝使諭之降。 阿魯台欲來，眾不可，遂戰。 帝率精騎大呼衝擊，矢下如注，阿魯台墜馬，遂大敗，追奔百餘里乃還。 冬，阿魯台使來貢馬，帝納之。
The following year the emperor himself led five hundred thousand men beyond the frontier. When Buyanshir heard this he was terrified and wished to flee west with Arughtai, but Arughtai refused to follow. Their forces broke apart, and at last ruler and minister each went his own way. Buyanshir fled west; Arughtai fled east. The emperor pursued Buyanshir to the Onon River, where Buyanshir stood to fight. The emperor waved his troops forward in a fierce charge; at a single shout the enemy line broke. Buyanshir abandoned his baggage, livestock, and dependents and fled with only seven horsemen. The Onon River was where the Yuan founder had first begun his rise to power. As the army marched home and reached Jinglu Fortress, they encountered Arughtai, and the emperor sent word urging him to submit. Arughtai wished to surrender, but his followers refused, and battle was joined. The emperor led his elite cavalry in a thunderous charge. Arrows fell like rain, Arughtai was thrown from his horse, and his forces were utterly routed. The pursuit ran for more than a hundred li before the Ming troops turned back. That winter Arughtai sent envoys bearing tribute horses, and the emperor accepted the tribute.
13
越二年，本雅失裡為瓦剌馬哈木等所殺。 阿魯台已數入貢，帝俱厚報之，並還其向所俘同產兄妹二人。 至是，奏馬哈木等弒其主，又擅立答裡巴，願輸誠內附，請為故主復仇。 天子義之，封為和寧王。 自是，歲或一貢，或再貢，以為常。
Two years later Buyanshir was killed by Mahamu of the Oirats and his allies. Arughtai had already sent tribute on several occasions, and each time the emperor had rewarded him handsomely, returning as well two full siblings whom he had previously taken captive. Now he reported that Mahamu and the others had murdered their khan and installed Delbeg without authority. He pledged loyalty and offered to submit, asking permission to avenge his former lord. Moved by his cause, the emperor enfeoffed him as Prince of Hening. Thereafter he sent tribute once or twice each year, and this became the established practice.
14
十二年，帝征瓦剌。 阿魯台使部長以下來朝會。 賜米五十石，乾肉、酒糗、彩幣有差。 十四年，以戰敗瓦剌，使來獻俘。 十九年，阿魯台貢使至邊，要劫行旅，帝諭使戒戢之，由是驕蹇不至。
In the twelfth year of the reign the emperor marched against the Oirats. Arughtai sent his tribal chiefs and their subordinates to attend an audience at court. They were granted fifty shi of grain, together with dried meat, wine, provisions, and colored silks in varying amounts. In the fourteenth year, after defeating the Oirats in battle, he sent envoys to present captives to the court. In the nineteenth year Arughtai's tribute envoys waylaid travelers at the border. The emperor sent word ordering them to cease, but they grew arrogant and stopped sending tribute altogether.
15
阿魯台之內附，困於瓦剌，窮蹙而南，思假息塞外。 帝納而封之，母妻皆為王太夫人、王夫人。 數年生聚，畜牧日以蕃盛，遂慢我使者，拘留之。 其貢使歸，多行劫掠，部落亦時來窺塞。 二十年春，大人興和。 於是詔親征之。 阿魯台聞大軍出，懼，其母妻皆詈之曰：「大明皇帝何負爾，而必為逆！ 」於是盡棄其輜重馬畜於闊灤海側，以其孥直北徙。 帝命焚其輜重，收其馬畜，遂班師。
Arughtai had submitted because he was hard pressed by the Oirats, driven to desperation and pushed south in hopes of finding refuge beyond the frontier. The emperor accepted his submission and enfeoffed him; his mother and wife were both granted the titles Grand Lady of the Prince and Lady of the Prince. Over the next several years his people recovered and multiplied, and their herds grew daily more abundant. Then he began to treat Ming envoys with contempt and detained them. On the return journey his tribute envoys frequently robbed travelers, and his tribesmen also periodically prowled the frontier passes. In the spring of the twentieth year he launched a major assault on Xinghe. The emperor thereupon ordered a personal expedition against him. When Arughtai learned that the great army was on the march he was terrified. His mother and wife cursed him, saying, "What has the Great Ming emperor done to wrong you, that you must persist in rebellion! " He then abandoned all his baggage and livestock beside Lake Kuoluan and fled north with his dependents. The emperor ordered the abandoned baggage burned and the livestock seized, then marched the army home.
16
明年秋，邊將言阿魯台將入寇。 帝曰：「彼意朕必不復出，當先駐塞下待之。 」遂部分寧陽侯陳懋為先鋒，至宿嵬山不見敵，遇王子也先土干率妻子部屬來降。 帝封為忠勇王，賜姓名曰金忠。 忠勇王至京師，數請擊敵自效。 帝曰：「姑待之。 」二十二年春，開平守將奏阿魯台盜邊，群臣勸帝如忠勇王言。 帝復親征，師次荅蘭納木兒河，得諜者，知阿魯台遠遁。 帝意亦厭兵，乃下詔暴阿魯台罪惡，而宥其所部來降者，止勿殺。 車駕還，崩於榆木川。 未幾，阿魯台使來貢馬，仁宗已登極，詔納之。 自是，歲修職貢如永樂時。 時阿魯台數敗於瓦剌，部曲離散。 其屬把的等先後來歸，朝廷皆予官職，賜鈔幣，詔有司給供具。 自後來歸者，悉如例。 阿魯台日益蹙，乃率其屬東走兀良哈，駐牧遼塞。 諸將請出兵掩擊之，帝不聽。
The following autumn frontier commanders reported that Arughtai was preparing to raid the border. The emperor said, "He thinks I will never campaign beyond the frontier again. I shall encamp below the passes and wait for him. " He then deployed Ningyang Marquis Chen Mao as vanguard. When the vanguard reached Mount Suwei no enemy was found, but they encountered the prince Esen Toghan, who came to surrender with his wife, children, and followers. The emperor enfeoffed him as Prince of Zhongyong and granted him the Chinese name Jin Zhong. After reaching the capital, the Prince of Zhongyong repeatedly asked to lead troops against the enemy and prove his loyalty. The emperor replied, "Let us wait for now. " In the spring of the twenty-second year the Kaiping garrison commander reported that Arughtai was raiding the frontier, and the ministers urged the emperor to take the Prince of Zhongyong's advice. The emperor again took the field in person. When the army halted at the Tula River, a spy revealed that Arughtai had already fled deep into the steppe. The emperor had grown weary of campaigning. He issued an edict denouncing Arughtai's crimes but pardoning those of his followers who surrendered, ordering that they be spared. The emperor turned homeward but died on the Yumu River before reaching the capital. Before long Arughtai sent envoys bearing tribute horses. The Renzong Emperor had already taken the throne, and he ordered the tribute accepted. Thereafter tribute was sent each year as it had been during the Yongle reign. By then Arughtai had suffered repeated defeats at the hands of the Oirats, and his followers had scattered. His followers, including Badi, submitted one after another. The court granted them official posts, bestowed paper money and silks, and ordered the appropriate offices to provide for their needs. All who submitted thereafter were treated according to the same precedent. Arughtai's position grew daily more desperate. He led his followers east to the Uriangkhai and encamped to pasture along the Liao frontier. The generals asked permission to launch a surprise attack, but the emperor refused.
17
宣德九年，阿魯台復為脫脫不花所襲，妻子死，孳畜略盡，獨與其子失捏乾等徙居母納山、察罕腦剌等處。 未幾，瓦剌脫懽襲殺阿魯台及失捏干，於是阿魯檯子阿卜只俺及其孫妻速木答思等喪敗無依，來乞內附。 帝憐而撫之。
In the ninth year of Xuande, Arughtai was again attacked by Togto Buqa. His wife and children were killed, his livestock and dependents were nearly all lost, and he fled with only his son Shinigin and a few others to Mount Mona, Chaghan Nao'er, and other refuges. Before long the Oirat leader Toghan attacked and killed Arughtai and Shinigin. Arughtai's son Abuzhan, his grandson's wife Sumudasi, and others, left destitute after their defeat, came begging to submit to the Ming. The emperor took pity on them and extended his protection.
18
未幾，脫脫不花捕阿台等殺之。 脫脫不花者，故元後，韃靼長也。 瓦剌脫忄雚既擊殺阿魯台，悉收其部，兼併賢義、安樂二王之眾，欲自立為可汗。 眾不可，乃立脫脫不花，以阿魯台眾屬之，自為丞相，陽推奉之，實不承其號令。
Before long Togto Buqa captured Atai and his followers and put them to death. Togto Buqa was a descendant of the Yuan imperial house and a chieftain of the Tartars. After the Oirat leader Toghan had killed Arughtai, he absorbed all of Arughtai's tribes and annexed the forces of the Princes of Xianyi and Anle, intending to proclaim himself khan. His followers would not accept this, so he installed Togto Buqa as khan, assigned Arughtai's followers to him, and took the title of chief minister himself—paying lip service to Togto Buqa while ignoring his orders in practice.
19
脫懽死，子也先嗣，益桀驁自雄，諸部皆下之，脫脫不花具可汗名而已。 脫脫不花歲來朝貢，天子皆厚報之，比諸蕃有加，書稱之曰達達可汗，賜賚並及其妃。
When Toghan died his son Esen succeeded him. Esen grew ever more fierce and overbearing until all the tribes submitted to him, leaving Togto Buqa with nothing but the empty title of khan. Togto Buqa sent tribute to court each year, and the emperor always responded with lavish gifts, treating him more generously than other foreign rulers. Imperial letters addressed him as the Dada Khan, and gifts were bestowed on him and his consort alike.
20
十四年秋，也先謀大舉入寇，脫脫不花止之曰：「吾儕服食，多資大明，何忍為此？ 」也先不聽，曰：「可汗不為，吾當自為。 」遂分道，俾脫脫不花侵遼東，而自擁眾從大同入。 帝親征之，駕於土木陷焉。 景皇帝自監國即位，尊帝為太上皇帝。 明年秋，上皇歸自也先所。 事載《瓦剌傳》。
In the autumn of the fourteenth year Esen planned a major invasion. Togto Buqa tried to stop him, saying, "Our clothing and food depend largely on the Great Ming—how can we bring ourselves to do this? " Esen refused to listen. "If the khan will not act," he said, "I shall act on my own. " They then divided their forces, sending Togto Buqa to raid Liaodong while Esen himself led his army in through Datong. The emperor marched out to meet them in person, and the imperial army was trapped at Tumu. The Jing Emperor, who had been regent, took the throne and honored the captured emperor as the Retired Emperor. The following autumn the Retired Emperor returned from captivity in Esen's camp. The full account is given in the Biography of the Oirats.
21
脫脫不花自上皇歸後，修貢益勤。 嘗妻也先姊，生子，也先欲立之，不從。 也先亦疑其與中國通，將害己，遂治兵相攻。 也先殺脫脫不花，收其妻子孳畜，給諸部屬，而自立為可汗。 時景皇帝二年也。 朝廷稱也先為瓦剌可汗。
After the Retired Emperor's return Togto Buqa sent tribute with ever greater diligence. He had married Esen's elder sister and had a son by her. Esen wished to install the boy as khan, but Togto Buqa refused. Esen also suspected that Togto Buqa was colluding with China and plotting against him, and so he mobilized his forces for war. Esen killed Togto Buqa, seized his wife, children, and livestock, distributed the spoils among his followers, and proclaimed himself khan. This was in the second year of the Jing Emperor's reign. The court addressed Esen as Khan of the Oirats.
22
未幾，為所部阿剌知院所殺。 韃靼部長孛來復攻破阿剌，求脫脫不花子麻兒可兒立之，號小王子。 阿剌死，而孛來與其屬毛裡孩等皆雄視部中，於是韃靼復熾。
Before long he was killed by Alzhiyuan, one of his own followers. The Tartar chieftain Bolai defeated Alzhiyuan in turn, found Togto Buqa's son Markörgis, and installed him under the title Little Prince. After Alzhiyuan's death Bolai and his follower Molihai dominated the tribes, and Tartar power revived.
23
景泰六年遣使入貢。 英宗復辟，遣都督馬政往賜故伯顏帖木兒妻幣。 孛來留之，而遣使入賀，欲獻璽。 帝敕之曰：「璽已非真，即真，亦秦不祥物耳，獻否從爾便。 第無留我使，以速爾禍。 」時敵數寇威遠諸衛，夏，定遠伯石彪敗之於磨兒山。
In the sixth year of Jingtai they sent envoys to offer tribute. After the Yingzong Emperor regained the throne he sent Commissioner-in-Chief Ma Zheng to bestow silks on the widow of the late Bayan Temür. Bolai detained Ma Zheng but sent his own envoys to offer congratulations and proposed to present the imperial seal. The emperor replied, "The seal is already a forgery; even if it were genuine, it would still be the ill-omened seal of Qin. Present it or not, as you please. But do not detain my envoy, or you will only hasten your own ruin. " Meanwhile the enemy repeatedly raided the guards around Weiyuan. That summer Dingyuan Earl Shi Biao defeated them at Mount Mo'er.
24
天順二年，孛來大舉寇陝西，安遠侯柳溥御之輒敗，而飾小捷以聞。 明年春，敵入安邊營，石彪等破之，都督周賢、指揮李钅監戰死。 四年復寇榆林，彰武伯楊信拒卻之。 再入，敗之於金雞峪。 未幾，復大掠陝西諸邊，廷臣請治各守將罪，帝宥之。 五年春，寇入平虜城，誘指揮許顒等入伏，殺之。 邊報日亟，命侍郎白圭、都御史王竑往視師。 秋，孛來求款，帝使詹升齎敕往諭。 孛來遣使隨升來貢，請改大同舊貢道，而由陝西蘭縣入，許之。 未幾，復糾其屬毛裡孩等入河西。 明年春，圭等分巡西邊，圭遇敵於固原川，竑遇敵於紅崖子川，皆破之。 帝賜璽書獎勵，敕孛來使臣仍從大同入貢。
In the second year of Tianshun Bolai launched a major raid into Shaanxi. Anyuan Marquis Liu Pu met him and was repeatedly defeated, yet reported minor victories to the court. The following spring the enemy entered Anbian Camp. Shi Biao and others routed them, but Commissioner-in-Chief Zhou Xian and Commander Li Jian were killed in battle. In the fourth year they raided Yulin again, but Zhangwu Earl Yang Xin drove them back. When they invaded again he defeated them at Jinjiyu. Before long they raided widely along the Shaanxi frontier again. Court officials asked that the frontier commanders be punished, but the emperor pardoned them. In the spring of the fifth year the raiders entered Pinglu Fortress, lured Commanders Xu Yong and others into an ambush, and killed them. Frontier reports grew daily more urgent, and Vice Minister Bai Gui and Censor-in-Chief Wang Hong were dispatched to inspect the armies. That autumn Bolai sought peace, and the emperor sent Zhan Sheng with an edict to address him. Bolai sent envoys to accompany Sheng and offer tribute, asking to abandon the old tribute route through Datong and enter instead by Lan County in Shaanxi. The request was granted. Before long he again rallied his follower Molihai and others to raid Hexi. The following spring Gui and the others toured the western frontier separately. Gui defeated the enemy at Guyuan River, and Wang Hong defeated them at Hongyazi River. The emperor sent sealed letters of commendation and ordered Bolai's envoys to resume the tribute route through Datong.
25
時麻兒可兒復與孛來相仇殺。 麻兒可兒死，眾共立馬可古兒吉思，亦號小王子。 自是，韃靼部長益各專擅。 小王子稀通中國，傳世次，多莫可考。 孛來等每歲入貢，數寇掠，往來塞下，以西攻瓦剌為辭，又數要劫三衛。 七年冬，貢使及關，帝卻之，以大學士李賢言乃止。 八年春，御史陳選言：「韃靼部落，孛來最強，又密招三衛諸蕃，相結屯住。 去冬來朝，要我賞宴，窺我虛實，其犯邊之情已露。 而我邊關守臣，因循怠慢，城堡不修，甲仗不利，軍士不操習，甚至富者納月錢而安閒，貧者迫飢寒而逃竄。 邊備廢弛，緩急何恃？ 乞敕在邊諸臣，痛革前弊。 其鎮守、備御等官，亦宜以時黜陟，庶能者知奮，怠者知警。 至厄塞要害之處，或益官軍，或設營堡，或用墩台，咸須處置得宜，歲遣大臣巡視，庶邊防有備，寇氛可戢。 」報聞。
At this time Markörgis was again locked in mutual raids and killings with Bolai. When Markörgis died the tribes jointly installed Mongke Gerisen, who was also styled the Little Prince. From this time on Tartar chieftains increasingly ruled their own domains independently. The Little Prince had little contact with China, and the line of succession is largely impossible to trace. Bolai and others sent tribute each year yet repeatedly raided the frontier, moving back and forth below the passes. They claimed to be campaigning west against the Oirats, but also repeatedly waylaid the Three Guards. In the winter of the seventh year the emperor rejected Bolai's tribute envoys at the pass, but relented only after Grand Secretary Li Xian intervened. In the spring of the eighth year Censor Chen Xuan memorialized: "Among the Tartar tribes Bolai is the strongest. He has also secretly summoned the peoples of the Three Guards to join him and encamp together. Last winter he came to court, demanded rewards and banquets, and spied on our defenses. His intent to raid the frontier is already plain. Yet our frontier commanders are complacent and negligent. Fortresses go unrepaired, arms and armor are unserviceable, and soldiers receive no drill. The wealthy pay monthly fees to avoid duty, while the poor, driven by hunger and cold, desert and flee. Frontier defenses lie in ruins—what shall we rely on in an emergency? I beg that frontier officials be ordered to root out these abuses. Garrison and defense officials should also be promoted or dismissed in timely fashion, so that the capable are encouraged to strive and the negligent are put on notice. At strategic passes and key points, whether by adding garrison troops, building camps and fortresses, or erecting beacon towers, all measures must be properly arranged. Each year senior officials should be sent to inspect the frontier, so that defenses may be ready and raiders restrained. The memorial was noted.
26
成化元年春，孛來誘兀良哈九萬騎入遼河，武安侯鄭宏御卻之。 秋，散掠延綏。 冬，復大入。 命彰武伯楊信率山西兵，都御史項忠率陝西兵御之，少卻。 未幾，復渡河曲，圍黃甫川堡，官軍力戰，乃引去。
In the spring of the first year of Chenghua Bolai lured ninety thousand Uriangkhai horsemen into the Liao River valley. Wu'an Marquis Zheng Hong met and drove them back. That autumn they scattered in raids across Yan-Sui. That winter they launched another major raid. The emperor ordered Zhangwu Earl Yang Xin to lead Shanxi troops and Censor-in-Chief Xiang Zhong to lead Shaanxi troops against them, and the raiders fell back somewhat. Before long they crossed the river bend again, besieged Huangfuchuan Fortress, and withdrew only after government troops fought them off.
27
始，韃靼之來也，或在遼東、宣府、大同，或在寧夏、莊浪、甘肅，去來無常，為患不久。 景泰初，始犯延慶，然部落少，不敢深入。 天順間，有阿羅出者，率屬潛入河套居之，遂逼近西邊。 河套，古朔方郡，唐張仁願築三受降城處也。 地在黃河南，自寧夏至偏頭關，延袤二千里，饒水草，外為東勝衛。 東勝而外，土平衍，敵來，一騎不能隱，明初守之，後以曠絕內徙。 至是，孛來與小王子、毛裡孩等先後繼至，擄中國人為鄉導，抄掠延綏無虛時，而邊事以棘。
At first the Tartars might strike Liaodong, Xuanfu, or Datong, or Ningxia, Zhuanglang, or Gansu; their movements were erratic and the damage seldom lasted. In the early Jingtai years they first raided Yanqing, but their bands were small and they did not dare push far inland. During the Tianshun period a leader named Aluochu led his followers secretly into the Ordos bend to settle there, pressing close against the western frontier. The Ordos bend was the ancient Shuofang commandery, where the Tang general Zhang Renyuan had built the three cities that received surrender. It lay south of the Yellow River, from Ningxia to Piantou Pass—a stretch of two thousand li rich in pasture and water—with the guard of Dongsheng beyond. Beyond Dongsheng the land was flat and open, offering no cover even for a lone rider. The early Ming had garrisoned it, but later, finding the region too remote, the court withdrew the posts inland. By then Bolai, the Little Prince, Molihai, and others had arrived in turn. They took Chinese captives as guides and raided Yan-Sui without pause, and the frontier crisis sharpened.
28
二年夏，大入延綏。 帝命楊信充總兵官，都督趙勝為副，率京軍及諸邊卒二萬人討之。 信先以議事赴闕，未至。 敵散掠平涼，入靈州及固原，長驅寇靜寧、隆德諸處。 冬，復入延綏，參將湯胤績戰死。
In the second year, summer, they launched a major raid into Yan-Sui. The emperor appointed Yang Xin supreme commander, with Regional Commander Zhao Sheng as his deputy, and ordered them to lead twenty thousand capital troops and frontier soldiers against the raiders. Yang Xin had gone to court first to consult on strategy and had not yet reached the frontier. The raiders scattered across Pingliang, entered Lingzhou and Guyuan, and swept deep into Jingning, Longde, and neighboring districts. That winter they entered Yan-Sui again, and Assistant Commander Tang Yinji was killed in action.
29
未幾，諸部內爭，孛來弒馬可古兒吉思，毛裡孩殺孛來，更立他可汗。 斡羅出者復與毛裡孩相仇殺，毛裡孩遂殺其所立可汗，逐斡羅出，而遣使入貢。 尋渡河掠大同。 三年春，帝命撫寧侯硃永等征之。 會毛裡孩再乞通貢，而別部長孛魯乃亦遣人來朝。 帝許之，詔永等駐軍塞上。
Before long the tribes turned on one another. Bolai murdered Mongke Gerisen; Molihai killed Bolai in turn and installed another khan. Wolochu again clashed with Molihai. Molihai killed the khan he had installed, drove Wolochu out, and sent envoys to court with tribute. Soon afterward they crossed the river and raided Datong. In the spring of the third year the emperor ordered Funing Marquis Zhu Yong and others to take the field against them. Molihai was again petitioning to resume tribute, and Berenai, chieftain of another division, also sent envoys to court. The emperor granted their requests and ordered Zhu Yong and the others to hold their armies on the frontier.
30
四年秋，給事中程萬里上言：「毛裡孩久不朝貢，窺伺邊疆，其情叵測。 然臣度其有可敗者三。 近我邊地才二三日程，彼客我主，一也。 兼併諸部，馳驅不息，既驕且疲，二也。 比來散逐水草，部落四分，兵力不一，三也。 宜選精兵二萬，每三千人為一軍，統以驍將，嚴其賞罰，使探毛裡孩所在，潛師搗之，破之必矣。 」帝壯之，而不能用。 冬寇延綏。 明年春再入。 守將許寧等輒擊敗之。 冬復糾三衛入寇，延綏、榆林大擾。
In the autumn of the fourth year Supervising Secretary Cheng Wanli memorialized: "Molihai has long neglected tribute missions and watches our frontier with ill intent. His designs are impossible to read. Yet I believe he has three weaknesses we can exploit. Our frontier is only two or three days' march away—they are intruders on our ground, and we are the hosts. That is the first. He has swallowed up the tribes and drives his men without rest; they are at once overbearing and worn down. That is the second. Lately they have scattered to follow pasture and water, and the tribes are split four ways with unequal strength. That is the third. We should choose twenty thousand picked troops, divide them into units of three thousand under bold commanders, enforce discipline strictly, locate Molihai, and strike him with a concealed force. He can be broken. " The emperor was impressed but did not act on the plan. That winter they raided Yan-Sui. The following spring they entered again. The defending generals Xu Ning and others promptly attacked and drove them back. That winter they again rallied the Three Guards and raided; Yan-Sui and Yulin were thrown into turmoil.
31
六年春，大同巡撫王越遣游擊許寧擊敗之； 楊信等亦大破之於胡柴氵冓。 時孛魯乃與斡羅出合別部加思蘭、孛羅忽亦入據河套，為久居計。 延綏告急，帝命永為將軍，以王越參贊軍務，使禦敵。 永至，數以捷聞，越等皆升賞，論功永世侯，而敵據套自如。
In the spring of the sixth year Datong Grand Coordinator Wang Yue sent Guerrilla Commander Xu Ning to attack and defeat them; Yang Xin and others also crushed them at Huchai Gully. At this time Berenai and Wolochu joined Qojasan and Boluohu of another division, and they too entered the Ordos bend intending to settle there permanently. Yan-Sui sent urgent reports, and the emperor appointed Zhu Yong general, with Wang Yue to assist in military affairs, to meet the enemy. After Zhu Yong arrived he repeatedly reported victories; Wang Yue and the others were promoted and rewarded, and Yong was enfeoffed as a hereditary marquis for his merit—yet the enemy still held the bend.
32
七年春，永上戰守二策，廷議以糧匱馬乏，難於進剿，請命邊將慎守禦以圖萬全。 於是吏部侍郎葉盛巡邊，偕延綏巡撫餘子俊及越議築邊牆，設立台堡。 冬，敵入塞，參將錢亮敗績，越等不能救。 兵部尚書白圭請擇遣大將軍專事敵，會盛還，越亦赴京計事，乃集廷議，請大發兵搜套。 帝以武靖侯趙輔為將軍，節制諸路，王越仍督師。 敵大入延綏，輔不能御，遂召還，以寧晉伯劉聚代之，聚亦未有功。 而毛裡孩、孛魯乃、斡羅出稍衰，滿都魯入河套稱可汗，加思蘭為太師。
In the spring of the seventh year Zhu Yong submitted plans for both attack and defense. Court discussion held that supplies were short and horses worn out, making a forward campaign impractical, and urged frontier generals to hold the line carefully instead. Thereupon Vice Minister of Personnel Ye Sheng toured the frontier and, with Yan-Sui Grand Coordinator Yu Zijun and Wang Yue, planned the construction of a frontier wall and a network of beacon towers and fortresses. That winter the enemy broke through the frontier; Assistant Commander Qian Liang was defeated, and Wang Yue and the others could not reach him in time. Minister of War Bai Gui asked that a senior general be chosen to focus solely on the enemy. When Ye Sheng returned and Wang Yue came to the capital as well, the court met and called for a major expedition to drive the raiders from the bend. The emperor appointed Wujing Marquis Zhao Fu general with authority over all frontier routes, while Wang Yue continued to direct operations. The enemy launched a major raid into Yan-Sui. Zhao Fu could not repel them and was recalled; Ningjin Earl Liu Ju replaced him, but he too won no success. Meanwhile Molihai, Berenai, and Wolochu gradually waned. Mandulu entered the Ordos bend and proclaimed himself khan, with Qojasan as grand preceptor.
33
九年秋，滿都魯等與孛羅忽並寇韋州。 王越偵知敵盡行，其老弱巢紅鹽池，乃與許寧及游擊周玉率輕騎晝夜疾馳至，分薄其營，前後夾擊，大破之。 復邀擊於韋州。 滿都魯等敗歸，孳畜廬帳蕩盡，妻孥皆喪亡，相顧悲哭去。 自是不復居河套，邊患少弭； 間盜邊，弗敢大入，亦數遣使朝貢。
In the autumn of the ninth year Mandulu and Boluohu jointly raided Weizhou. Wang Yue learned through scouts that the enemy had marched out in full strength, leaving their old and weak encamped at Red Salt Pool. He led Xu Ning and Guerrilla Commander Zhou Yu with light cavalry, riding day and night, split his force to press the camps, and struck from both sides, crushing them. He ambushed them again at Weizhou. Mandulu and the others fled back in defeat. Their herds and tents were wiped out, wives and children were lost, and they withdrew wailing in despair. From then on they no longer settled in the Ordos bend, and the frontier crisis eased somewhat; they still raided the frontier from time to time but no longer dared to invade on a large scale, and they also sent tribute envoys to court repeatedly.
34
初，加思蘭以女妻滿都魯，立為可汗。 久之殺孛羅忽，並其眾，益專恣。 滿都魯部脫羅干、亦思馬因謀殺之。 尋滿都魯亦死，諸強酋相繼略盡，邊人稍得息肩。
At first Qojasan gave his daughter to Mandulu in marriage and installed him as khan. In time he killed Boluohu and absorbed his followers, growing ever more domineering. Toragan and Isibayan of Mandulu's division plotted to assassinate him. Before long Mandulu died as well, and one by one the powerful chieftains were gone; the frontier at last gained a little breathing room.
35
時中官汪直怙恩用事，思以邊功自樹，王越、硃永附之。 十六年春，邊將上言，傳聞敵將渡河，遽以永為將軍。 直與越督師至邊，未及期，襲敵於威寧海子，大破之，又敗之於大同。 永晉公爵，予世襲，越封威寧伯，直增祿至三百石。 未幾，詔以越代永總兵。 於是亦思馬因等益糾眾盜邊，延及遼塞。 秋，敵三萬騎寇大同，連營五十里，殺掠人畜數萬。 總兵許寧御之，兵敗，以捷聞。 敵既得利，長驅入順聖川，散掠渾源、朔諸州。 宣府巡撫秦紘、總兵周玉力戰卻之。 山西巡撫邊鏞，參將支玉等悉力捍禦，敵去輒復來，迄成化末無寧歲。
At this time the palace eunuch Wang Zhi, secure in imperial favor, held power and sought glory on the frontier; Wang Yue and Zhu Yong aligned themselves with him. In the spring of the sixteenth year frontier generals reported that the enemy were about to cross the river, and Zhu Yong was hastily appointed general. Wang Zhi and Wang Yue took command on the frontier and, ahead of schedule, surprised the enemy at Weining Lake and routed them, then defeated them again at Datong. Zhu Yong was promoted to duke with a hereditary fief, Wang Yue was made Earl of Weining, and Wang Zhi's stipend was raised to three hundred shi. Before long an edict appointed Wang Yue to replace Zhu Yong as supreme commander. Thereupon Isibayan and his allies gathered larger bands to raid the frontier, and the trouble spread to the Liaodong frontier. That autumn thirty thousand enemy horsemen raided Datong. Their camps stretched fifty li, and they killed and plundered tens of thousands of people and livestock. Supreme Commander Xu Ning met them, was defeated, and yet reported a victory. Having taken their spoils, the enemy drove deep into the Shunsheng valley and scattered in raids across Hunyuan, Shuo, and neighboring prefectures. Xuanfu Grand Coordinator Qin Hong and Supreme Commander Zhou Yu fought hard and drove them back. Shanxi Grand Coordinator Bian Yong, Assistant Commander Zhi Yu, and others defended with all their strength. The enemy withdrew and returned again, and until the end of the Chenghua reign the frontier knew no quiet year.
36
亦思馬因死，入寇者復稱小王子，又有伯顏猛可王。 弘治元年夏，小王子奉書求貢，自稱大元大可汗。 朝廷方務優容，許之。 自是，與伯顏猛可王等屢入貢，漸往來套中，出沒為寇。 八年，北部亦卜剌因王等入套駐牧。 於是小王子及脫羅干之子火篩相倚日強，為東西諸邊患。 其年，三入遼東，多殺掠。 明年，宣、大、延綏諸境俱被殘。
After Isibayan died, the raiders again marched under the name of the Little Prince, and Prince Bayan Mengke also appeared. In the summer of the first year of Hongzhi the Little Prince sent a letter requesting tribute, styling himself Great Khan of the Great Yuan. The court was then intent on conciliation and granted the request. From then on he and Prince Bayan Mengke and others sent tribute repeatedly, gradually moving back and forth within the bend, raiding whenever they appeared. In the eighth year the northern chieftain Yibula and others entered the bend to pasture. Thereupon the Little Prince and Huosai, son of Toragan, leaning on each other, grew daily stronger and plagued the eastern and western frontiers. That year they entered Liaodong three times and killed and plundered heavily. The following year Xuanfu, Datong, and Yan-Sui were all ravaged.
37
十一年秋，王越既節制諸邊，乃率輕兵襲敵於賀蘭山後，破之。 明年，敵擁眾入大同、寧夏境，游擊王杲敗績，參將秦恭、副總兵馬升逗遛不進，皆論死。 時平江伯陳銳為總兵，侍郎許進督師，久無功，被劾去，以保國公硃暉、侍郎史琳代之，太監苗逵監軍。
In the autumn of the eleventh year, after Wang Yue had been given overall command of the frontiers, he led light troops in a surprise raid behind Helan Mountain and routed the enemy. The following year the enemy gathered a large force and entered Datong and Ningxia. Guerrilla Commander Wang Gao was defeated; Assistant Commander Qin Gong and Vice Supreme Commander Ma Sheng hung back and did not advance, and all were sentenced to death. At this time Pingjiang Earl Chen Rui was supreme commander and Vice Minister Xu Jin directed operations. After long months without success they were impeached and removed; Defender of the State Zhu Hui and Vice Minister Shi Lin replaced them, with the eunuch Miao Kui supervising the army.
38
十三年冬，小王子復居河套。 明年春，吏部侍郎王鏊上御敵八策：一曰定廟算，二曰重主將，三曰嚴法令，四曰恤邊民，五曰廣招募，六曰用間，七曰分兵，八曰出奇。 帝命所司知之。 時敵以八千騎東駐遼塞下，攻入長勝堡，殺掠殆盡。 秋，暉等以五路之師夜襲敵於河套，斬首三級，驅孳畜千餘歸，賞甚厚。 小王子以十萬騎從花馬池、鹽池入，散掠固原、寧夏境，三輔震動，戕殺慘酷。
In the winter of the thirteenth year the Little Prince again settled in the Ordos bend. The following spring Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Ao submitted eight plans for meeting the enemy: fix the court's strategy; honor the chief commander; enforce discipline strictly; care for frontier people; broaden recruitment; employ spies; divide forces; and strike by surprise. The emperor ordered the relevant offices to take note. At this time eight thousand enemy horsemen encamped east on the Liaodong frontier, stormed Changsheng Fortress, and killed and plundered almost without mercy. That autumn Zhu Hui and the others sent five columns in a night attack on the enemy in the Ordos bend, took three heads, drove off more than a thousand head of livestock, and received lavish rewards. The Little Prince entered with one hundred thousand horsemen through Huamachi and Salt Pool, scattered raids across Guyuan and Ningxia, and shook the Three Adjuncts; the slaughter was savage.
39
十五年，以戶部尚書秦紘總制陝西。 夏，敵入遼東清河堡，至密雲，旋西掠偏頭關。 秋，復以五千騎犯遼東長安堡，副總兵劉祥御之，斬首五十一級，敵乃退。 明年，稍靖。
In the fifteenth year Minister of Revenue Qin Hong was put in overall charge of Shaanxi. In summer the enemy entered Qinghe Fortress in Liaodong, reached Miyun, then turned west to raid Piantou Pass. That autumn five thousand horsemen raided Chang'an Fortress in Liaodong. Vice Supreme Commander Liu Xiang met them, took fifty-one heads, and the enemy withdrew. The following year the frontier grew somewhat quieter.
40
十七年春，敵上書請貢，許之，竟不至； 仍入大同殺墩軍，犯宣府及莊浪，守將衛勇、白玉等御卻之。 明年春，敵三萬騎圍靈州，復散掠內地，指揮仇鉞、總兵李祥擊走之。 敵大舉入寇宣府，總兵張俊御之，大敗，裨將張雄、穆榮戰歿。
In the spring of the seventeenth year the enemy sent a letter requesting tribute. The court granted it, yet they never came; instead they entered Datong and killed beacon soldiers, struck Xuanfu and Zhuanglang, and defending generals Wei Yong and Bai Yu drove them back. The following spring thirty thousand enemy horsemen besieged Lingzhou, then scattered in raids inland; Commander Qiu Yue and Supreme Commander Li Xiang attacked and drove them off. The enemy launched a major raid into Xuanfu. Supreme Commander Zhang Jun met them and was routed; Assistant Generals Zhang Xiong and Mu Rong were killed in action.
41
武宗嗣位，覆命暉、琳出御。 冬，敵入鎮夷所，指揮劉經死之。 復自花馬池毀垣入，掠隆德、靜寧、會寧諸處，關中大擾，以楊一清為總制。 時正德元年春也。
When Emperor Wuzong succeeded to the throne, Zhu Hui and Shi Lin were again ordered to the frontier. That winter the enemy entered Zhenyi Station; Commander Liu Jing was killed in action. They broke through the wall at Huamachi again and raided Longde, Jingning, Huining, and neighboring districts. Guanzhong was thrown into turmoil, and Yang Yiqing was appointed overall commander. This was in the spring of the first year of Zhengde.
42
劉瑾用事，監軍皆閹人，一清不得職去，文貴、才寬相繼受事。 二年，敵入寧夏、莊浪及定遼後衛諸境，守將皆逮問。
Liu Jin held power, army supervisors were all eunuchs, and Yang Yiqing left office unable to exercise his command. Wen Gui and Cai Kuan succeeded one another in the post. In the second year the enemy entered Ningxia, Zhuanglang, and the territory of Dingliao Rear Guard, and the defending generals were all arrested and questioned.
43
四年，敵數寇大同。 冬，才寬禦敵於花馬池，中伏死。 總兵馬昂與別部亦孛來戰於木瓜山，勝之，斬三百六十五級，獲馬畜六百餘，軍器二千九百餘。
In the fourth year the enemy repeatedly raided Datong. That winter Cai Kuan met the enemy at Huamachi, fell into an ambush, and was killed. Supreme Commander Ma Ang fought Yibolai of another division at Mugua Mountain and won, taking three hundred sixty-five heads, more than six hundred horses and livestock, and more than twenty-nine hundred pieces of military equipment.
44
明年，北部亦卜剌與小王子仇殺。 亦卜剌竄西海，阿爾禿廝與合，逼脅洮西屬番，屢入寇。 巡撫張翼、總兵王勳不能制，漸深入，邊人苦之。 八年夏，擁眾來川，遣使詣翼所，乞邊地駐牧修貢。 翼啖以金帛，令遠徙，亦卜剌遂西掠烏斯藏，據之。 自是洮、岷、松潘無寧歲。
The following year the northern chieftain Yibula and the Little Prince turned on each other in mutual raids and killings. Yibula fled to the Western Sea, where A'ertusi joined him. Together they intimidated the dependent tribes west of the Tao River and raided again and again. Grand Coordinator Zhang Yi and Supreme Commander Wang Xun could not contain them. The raiders pushed ever deeper inland, and the frontier people suffered terribly. In the summer of the eighth year they gathered a large force and came to the river valley, sending envoys to Zhang Yi's headquarters to request pasture on frontier lands and a resumption of tribute. Zhang Yi placated them with gold and silk and ordered them to move far away. Yibula then raided west into Tibet and seized the territory. From then on Tao, Min, and Songpan knew no year of peace.
45
小王子數入寇，殺掠尤慘。 復以五萬騎攻大同，趣朔州，掠馬邑。 帝命咸寧侯仇鉞總兵御之，戰於萬全衛，斬三級，而所失亡十倍，以捷聞。 明年秋，敵連營數十，寇宣、大塞，而別遣萬騎掠懷安。 總制叢蘭告急，命太監張永督宣、大、延綏兵，都督白玉為大將，協蘭守禦，京師戒嚴。 已，敵逾懷安趣蔚州，至平虜城南，蘭等預置毒飯於田間如農家餉，而設伏以待。 敵至，中毒，伏猝發，多死者。 其年，小王子部長卜兒孩以內難復奔據西海，出沒寇西北邊。
The Little Prince raided repeatedly, and the killing and plundering were especially savage. He again attacked Datong with fifty thousand horsemen, pressed toward Shuozhou, and raided Mayi. The emperor appointed Xianning Marquis Qiu Yue supreme commander to meet them. At Wanquan Guard they took three heads, but their losses were ten times greater—and still a victory was reported. The following autumn the enemy set dozens of linked camps, raided the Xuanfu and Datong frontier, and sent ten thousand horsemen separately to plunder Huai'an. Overall Commander Cong Lan sent urgent reports. The emperor ordered the eunuch Zhang Yong to supervise troops from Xuanfu, Datong, and Yan-Sui, with Regional Commander Bai Yu as chief general, to assist Lan in the defense. The capital was placed on alert. Soon afterward the enemy crossed Huai'an and pressed toward Yuzhou, reaching south of Pinglu City. Lan and his officers had planted poisoned food in the fields disguised as farmers' rations and laid an ambush. When the enemy arrived they ate the poisoned food; the ambush sprang, and many were killed. That year Buritai, a chieftain of the Little Prince's division, fled to the Western Sea after internal strife and began raiding the northwestern frontier in sudden strikes.
46
十一年秋，小王子以七萬騎分道入，與總兵潘浩戰於賈家灣。 浩再戰再敗，裨將硃春、王唐死之。 張永遇於老營坡，被創走居庸。 敵遂犯宣府，凡攻破城堡二十，殺掠人畜數萬。 浩奪三官，諸將降罰有差。
In the autumn of the eleventh year the Little Prince entered with seventy thousand horsemen by separate routes and fought Supreme Commander Pan Hao at Jiajia Bay. Pan Hao fought twice and lost both times. Assistant Generals Zhu Chun and Wang Tang were killed in action. Zhang Yong met them at Laoying Slope, was wounded, and fled toward Juyong Pass. The enemy then struck Xuanfu, storming twenty castles and fortresses and killing and plundering tens of thousands of people and livestock. Pan Hao was stripped of three ranks, and the other generals were demoted and punished to varying degrees.
47
十二年冬，小王子以五萬騎自榆林入寇，圍總兵王勳等於應州。 帝幸陽和，親部署，督諸將往援，殊死戰，敵稍卻。 明日復來攻，自辰至酉，戰百餘合，敵引而西，追至平虜、朔州，值大風黑霧，晝晦，帝乃還，命宣捷於朝。 是後歲犯邊，然不敢大入。
In the winter of the twelfth year the Little Prince entered from Yulin with fifty thousand horsemen and besieged Supreme Commander Wang Xun and his officers at Yingzhou. The emperor went in person to Yanghe, took command of the deployment, and directed the generals to the rescue. They fought desperately and the enemy fell back somewhat. The next day the enemy attacked again. From morning until evening they fought more than a hundred engagements before the enemy withdrew westward. Pursuit reached Pinglu and Shuozhou, but a great wind and black fog blotted out the day, and the emperor turned back and ordered victory proclaimed at court. After this they raided the frontier every year but no longer dared to invade on a large scale.
48
嘉靖四年春，以萬騎寇甘肅。 總兵姜奭御之於苦水墩，斬其魁。 明年犯大同及宣府，亦卜剌復駐牧賀蘭山後，數擾邊。 明年春，小王子兩寇宣府。 參將王經、關山先後戰死。 秋，以數萬騎犯寧夏塞，尚書王憲以總兵鄭卿等敗之，斬三百餘級。 明年春，掠山西。 夏，入大同中路，參將李蓁御卻之。 冬，復寇大同，指揮趙源戰死。
In the spring of the fourth year of Jiajing they raided Gansu with ten thousand horsemen. Supreme Commander Jiang Shi met them at Kushui Dun and killed their leader. The following year they struck Datong and Xuanfu. Yibula again pastured behind Helan Mountain and repeatedly harassed the frontier. The following spring the Little Prince raided Xuanfu twice. Assistant Commanders Wang Jing and Guan Shan were killed in action, one after the other. That autumn tens of thousands of horsemen struck the Ningxia frontier. Minister Wang Xian had Supreme Commander Zheng Qing and others defeat them and take more than three hundred heads. The following spring they plundered Shanxi. In summer they entered Datong by the middle route. Assistant Commander Li Zhen met them and drove them back. That winter they raided Datong again. Commander Zhao Yuan was killed in action.
49
十一年春，小王子乞通貢，未得命，怒，遂擁十萬騎入寇。 總制唐龍請許之，帝不聽。 龍連戰，頗有斬獲。
In the spring of the eleventh year the Little Prince petitioned to resume tribute. When no reply came he grew angry and gathered one hundred thousand horsemen to raid. Overall Commander Tang Long asked that the request be granted, but the emperor refused. Tang Long fought repeatedly and won a fair number of heads and captures.
50
時小王子最富強，控弦十餘萬，多畜貨貝，稍厭兵，乃徙幕東方，稱土蠻，分諸部落在西北邊者甚眾。 曰吉囊、曰俺答者，於小王子為從父行，據河套，雄黠喜兵，為諸部長，相率躪諸邊。
At this time the Little Prince was the richest and strongest of the chieftains. He commanded more than one hundred thousand bowmen and hoarded goods and treasure, but he gradually wearied of war. He moved his camp eastward and styled himself Tumen, while the tribes he left scattered along the northwestern frontier were very numerous. Gijad and Altan were the Little Prince's uncles. They held the Ordos bend, were bold, cunning, and warlike, and as chieftains of the tribes they led one another in ravaging the frontiers.
51
十二年春，吉囊擁眾屯套內，將犯延綏，邊臣有備，乃突以五萬騎渡河西，襲亦不剌、卜兒孩兩部，大破之。 卜兒孩為莊、寧邊患久，亦郎骨、土魯番諸蕃皆苦之，嘗因屬番帖木哥求貢市，朝廷未之許。 至是唐龍以卜兒孩衰敗遠徙，西海獲寧，請無更議款事。
In the spring of the twelfth year Gijad gathered a host and encamped within the bend, intending to strike Yan-Sui. Frontier officials were prepared, so he suddenly crossed west of the river with fifty thousand horsemen and crushed the divisions of Yibolai and Buritai. Buritai had long plagued the Zhuanglang and Ningxia frontier, and the tribes of Yilanggu, Turfan, and others also suffered under him. They once petitioned through the dependent tribesman Timuge for tribute markets, but the court refused. Tang Long now argued that with Buritai defeated and driven far away and the Western Sea at peace, the court should not reopen talks of peaceful overtures.
52
吉囊等既破西海，旋竊入宣府永寧境，大掠而去。 冬，犯鎮遠關，總兵王效、副總兵梁震敗之於柳門，又追敗之於蜂窩山，敵溺水死者甚眾。 明年春，寇大同。 秋，復由花馬池入犯，梁震及總兵劉文拒卻之。
After Gijad and his allies broke the Western Sea forces, they slipped into Yongning in Xuanfu, plundered heavily, and withdrew. That winter they struck Zhenyuan Pass. Supreme Commander Wang Xiao and Vice Supreme Commander Liang Zhen defeated them at Liumen, pursued them to Fengwo Mountain, and defeated them again. Many drowned. The following spring they raided Datong. That autumn they entered again through Huamachi. Liang Zhen and Supreme Commander Liu Wen met them and drove them back.
53
十五年夏，吉囊以十萬眾屯賀蘭山，分兵寇涼州，副總兵王輔御之，斬五十七級。 又入莊浪境，總兵姜奭遇之於分水嶺，三戰三勝之。 又入延綏及寧夏邊。 冬，復犯大同，入掠宣大塞，總制侍郎劉天和、總督尚書楊守禮及巡撫都御史楚書悉力御之。
In the summer of the fifteenth year Gijad encamped at Helan Mountain with one hundred thousand men, sent detachments to raid Liangzhou, and Vice Supreme Commander Wang Fu met them and took fifty-seven heads. They entered Zhuanglang again. Supreme Commander Jiang Shi met them at Fenshui Ridge, fought three engagements, and won all three. They struck the Yan-Sui and Ningxia frontier again. That winter they struck Datong again and plundered the Xuanfu and Datong frontier. Overall Commander Vice Minister Liu Tianhe, Governor Minister Yang Shouli, and Grand Coordinator Censor-in-Chief Chu Shu mustered all their strength to meet them.
54
十九年秋，書以總兵白爵等三敗敵於萬全右衛境，斬百餘級。 天和以總兵周尚文大破敵於黑水苑，斬吉囊子小十王。 明年春，守禮以總兵李義禦敵於鎮朔堡，以總兵楊信禦敵於甘肅，皆勝之。
In the autumn of the nineteenth year Chu Shu, with Supreme Commander Bai Jue and others, defeated the enemy three times within Wanquan Right Guard and took more than one hundred heads. Liu Tianhe and Supreme Commander Zhou Shangwen crushed the enemy at Heishui Park and killed Gijad's son Xiaoshiwang. The following spring Yang Shouli had Supreme Commander Li Yi meet the enemy at Zhenshuo Fortress and Supreme Commander Yang Xin meet them in Gansu; both won.
55
秋，俺答及其屬阿不孩遣使石天爵款大同塞，巡撫史道以聞，詔卻之。 以尚書樊繼祖督宣大兵，懸賞格購俺答、阿不孩首。 遂大舉內犯，俺答下石嶺關，趣太原。 吉囊田平虜衛入掠平定、壽陽諸處。 總兵丁璋、游擊周宇戰死，諸將多獲罪，繼祖獨蒙賞。
That autumn Altan and his follower Abunai sent the envoy Shi Tianjue to offer peaceful overtures at the Datong frontier. Grand Coordinator Shi Dao reported this, and the court rejected them. Minister Fan Jizu was put in charge of Xuanfu and Datong troops, and a bounty was posted for the heads of Altan and Abunai. Thereupon they launched a major invasion inland. Altan descended Shiling Pass and pressed toward Taiyuan. Gijad entered through Pinglu Guard and plundered Pingding, Shouyang, and neighboring districts. Supreme Commander Ding Zhang and Guerrilla Commander Zhou Yu were killed in action. Many generals were punished, yet Fan Jizu alone was rewarded.
56
二十一年夏，敵復遣天爵求貢。 大同巡撫龍大有誘縛之，上之朝，詭言用計擒獲。 帝悅，擢大有兵部侍郎，邊臣升賞者數十人，磔天爵於市。 敵怒，入寇，掠朔州，抵廣武，由太原南下，沁、汾、襄垣、長子皆被殘； 復從忻、崞、代而北，屯祁縣。 參將張世忠力戰，敵圍之數重。 自巳至申，所殺傷相當。 已而世忠矢盡見殺，百戶張宣、張臣俱死，敵遂從雁門故道去。 秋，復入朔州。 吉囊死，諸子狼台吉等散處河西，勢既分，俺答獨盛，歲數擾延綏諸邊。
In the summer of the twenty-first year the enemy again sent Tianjue to request tribute. Datong Grand Coordinator Long Dayou lured and bound him, sent him to court, and falsely claimed a stratagem had captured him. The emperor was pleased. He promoted Long Dayou to Vice Minister of War, rewarded dozens of frontier officials, and had Tianjue dismembered in the market. The enemy grew furious and raided again. They plundered Shuozhou, reached Guangwu, and swept south from Taiyuan. Qin, Fen, Xiangyuan, and Changzi were all ravaged; then they turned north through Xin, Guo, and Dai and encamped at Qixian. Assistant Commander Zhang Shizhong fought fiercely, but the enemy surrounded him in layer after layer. From mid-morning until late afternoon the killing and wounding on both sides were roughly equal. Before long Zhang Shizhong ran out of arrows and was killed. Company Commanders Zhang Xuan and Zhang Chen also died. The enemy then withdrew by the old Yanmen road. That autumn they entered Shuozhou again. Gijad died. His sons Langtaiji and others scattered across Hexi, and their power was divided. Altan alone flourished and harassed the Yan-Sui frontier year after year.
57
二十三年冬，小王子自萬全右衛入，至蔚州及完縣。 京師戒嚴。
In the winter of the twenty-third year the Little Prince entered from Wanquan Right Guard and reached Yuzhou and Wanxian. The capital was placed on alert.
58
二十四年秋，俺答犯延綏及大同，總兵張達拒卻之。 又犯鵓鴿峪，參將張鳳、指揮劉欽、千戶李瓚、生員王邦直等皆戰死。 會總督侍郎翁萬達、總兵周尚文嚴兵備陽和，敵引去。 明年夏，俺答覆遣使詣大同塞，求貢，邊卒殺之。 秋，復來請，萬達再疏以聞，帝不許。 敵以十萬騎西入保安，掠慶陽、環縣而東，以萬騎寇錦、義。 總督三邊侍郎曾銑率參將李珍等直搗敵巢於馬梁山後，斬百餘級，敵始退。 銑議復河套，大學士夏言主之。 帝方向用言，令銑圖上方略，以便宜從事。 明年夏，萬達復言：「敵自冬涉春屢求貢，詞恭，似宜許。 」不聽，責萬達罔瀆。 銑鳩兵繕塞，輒破敵。 既而帝意中變，言與銑竟得罪，斬西市。 敵益蓄忿思逞，廷臣不敢言復套事矣。
In the autumn of the twenty-fourth year Altan struck Yan-Sui and Datong. Supreme Commander Zhang Da met him and drove him back. He struck Boguge Valley again. Assistant Commander Zhang Feng, Commander Liu Qin, Company Commander Li Zan, student Wang Bangzhi, and others were all killed in action. Governor Vice Minister Weng Wanda and Supreme Commander Zhou Shangwen had strictly prepared the defenses at Yanghe, and the enemy withdrew. The following summer Altan again sent envoys to the Datong frontier to request tribute, and frontier soldiers killed them. That autumn they petitioned again. Weng Wanda memorialized once more, but the emperor refused. The enemy entered Bao'an from the west with one hundred thousand horsemen, plundered Qingyang and Huanxian, turned east, and sent ten thousand horsemen to raid Jin and Yi. Governor of the Three Frontiers Vice Minister Zeng Xuan led Assistant Commander Li Zhen and others in a direct strike on the enemy camp behind Mabliang Mountain, took more than one hundred heads, and the enemy withdrew. Zeng Xuan proposed recovering the Ordos bend, and Grand Secretary Xia Yan supported the plan. The emperor was then inclined to favor Xia Yan and ordered Zeng Xuan to draft strategy and act as circumstances permitted. The following summer Weng Wanda memorialized again: "Since winter through spring the enemy has repeatedly requested tribute. Their words are respectful, and it seems fitting to grant it. " The emperor refused and rebuked Weng Wanda for deceit and disrespect. Zeng Xuan gathered troops and repaired the frontier defenses, and whenever he fought he defeated the enemy. Before long the emperor changed his mind. Xia Yan and Zeng Xuan were punished in the end and executed at the Western Market. The enemy grew ever more resentful and eager to strike. Court ministers no longer dared speak of recovering the bend.
59
二十八年春，犯宣府滴水崖。 把總指揮江瀚、董暘戰死，全軍覆，遂犯永寧、大同。 總兵周尚文御之於曹家莊，大敗之，斬其魁。 會萬達自懷來赴援，宣府總兵趙國忠聞警，亦率千騎追擊，復連敗之。 是歲，犯西塞者五。
In the spring of the twenty-eighth year they struck Dingshui Cliff in Xuanfu. Detachment Commander Jiang Han and Dong Yang were killed in action and the whole detachment was wiped out. The enemy then struck Yongning and Datong. Supreme Commander Zhou Shangwen met them at Caojiazhuang, routed them, and killed their leader. Weng Wanda came from Huailai to reinforce, and Xuanfu Supreme Commander Zhao Guozhong, hearing the alarm, also led one thousand horsemen in pursuit. Together they inflicted successive defeats. That year the western frontier was struck five times.
60
二十九年春，俺答移駐威寧海子。 夏，犯大同，總兵張達、林椿死之。 敵引去，傳箭諸部大舉。 秋，循潮河川南下至古北口，都御史王汝孝率薊鎮兵御之。 敵陽引滿內向，而別遣精騎從間道潰牆入。 汝孝兵潰，遂大掠懷柔，圍順義，抵通州，分兵四掠，焚湖渠馬房。 畿甸大震。
In the spring of the twenty-ninth year Altan moved his camp to Weining Lake. In summer he struck Datong. Supreme Commander Zhang Da and Lin Chun were killed in action. The enemy withdrew and passed the war arrow among the tribes to summon a general mobilization. That autumn they followed the Chaohu River valley south to Gubeikou. Censor-in-Chief Wang Ruxiao led Jizhou troops to meet them. The enemy feigned a frontal advance while sending picked horsemen by a hidden path to break through the wall. Wang Ruxiao's army collapsed. The enemy plundered Huairou heavily, besieged Shunyi, reached Tongzhou, divided into four columns to raid, and burned the lake-channel horse farms. The capital region was thrown into shock.
61
敵大眾犯京師，大同總兵咸寧侯仇鸞、巡撫保定都御史楊守謙等，各以勤王兵至。 帝拜鸞為大將軍，使護諸軍。 鸞與守謙皆軿懦不敢戰，兵部尚書丁汝夔忄匡擾不知所為，閉門守。 敵焚掠三日夜，引去。 帝誅汝夔及守謙。 敵將出白羊口，鸞尾之。 敵猝東返，鸞出不意，兵潰，死傷千餘人。 敵乃徐由古北口出塞。 諸將收斬遺屍，得八十餘級，以捷聞。
The enemy's great host struck at the capital. Datong Supreme Commander Xianning Marquis Qiu Luan, Baoding Grand Coordinator Censor-in-Chief Yang Shouqian, and others each arrived with relief armies. The emperor invested Qiu Luan as great general and put him in command of the relief armies. Qiu Luan and Yang Shouqian were both cowardly and dared not fight. Minister of War Ding Ruao was panicked and at a loss, and simply shut the gates. The enemy burned and plundered for three days and nights, then withdrew. The emperor executed Ding Ruao and Yang Shouqian. As the enemy were about to exit Baiyang Pass, Qiu Luan followed in their rear. The enemy suddenly wheeled east. Caught unprepared, Qiu Luan's army collapsed, and more than a thousand were killed or wounded. The enemy then slowly withdrew through Gubeikou and crossed back beyond the frontier. The generals collected the enemy dead and took more than eighty heads, then reported a victory.
62
方俺答薄都城時，縱所擄馬房內官楊增持書入城求貢。 輔臣徐階等謂當以計款之，諭令退屯塞外，因邊臣以請。 俺答歸，遣子脫脫陳款。 時鸞方用事，乃議開馬市以中敵。 兵部郎中楊繼盛上疏爭之，不得。 明年春，以侍郎史道蒞其事，給白金十萬，開市大同，次及延、寧。 叛人蕭芹、呂明鎮者，故以罪亡入敵，挾白蓮邪教，與其黨趙全、丘富、周原、喬源諸人導俺答為患。 俺答市畢，旋入掠。 邊臣責之，以芹等為詞。 芹詭有術，能墮城。 敵試之不驗，遂縛芹及明鎮，而全、富等竟匿不出。 俺答覆請以牛馬易粟豆，求職役誥敕，又潛約河西諸部內犯，墮諸邊垣。 帝惡之，詔罷馬市，召道還。 自是，敵日寇掠西邊，邊人大困。
While Altan Khan was pressing close to the capital, he released the captured horse-farm eunuch Yang Zeng and sent him into the city with a letter requesting tribute. Chief ministers Xu Jie and others argued that he should be handled with diplomatic delay: Altan was to be told to withdraw and encamp beyond the frontier, and border officials would submit the tribute request on his behalf. Altan withdrew and sent his son Toto to present overtures of peace. Qiu Luan was then in power, and the court debated opening a horse market to win the enemy over. Yang Jisheng, supervising secretary in the Ministry of War, submitted a memorial in protest, but his objection was rejected. The following spring Vice Minister Shi Dao was put in charge of the arrangement. One hundred thousand taels of silver were allocated, and markets were opened at Datong and then extended to Yan'an and Ningxia. The renegades Xiao Qin and Lü Mingzhen had fled into Tartar territory as fugitives from justice. Espousing the White Lotus heresy, they and their followers—Zhao Quan, Qiu Fu, Zhou Yuan, Qiao Yuan, and others—guided Altan in his raids. As soon as Altan finished trading, he turned around and raided again. Border officials rebuked him, but he pleaded that Qin and the others were to blame. Qin falsely claimed to possess a technique that could bring cities down. The Tartars tested the claim and found it false. They bound Qin and Mingzhen, while Quan, Fu, and the others remained in hiding and refused to surrender. Altan again asked to trade cattle and horses for grain and beans, sought patent letters appointing his men to official posts, and secretly arranged with the Hexi tribes to invade and breach the border walls. The emperor was disgusted and issued an edict abolishing the horse market and recalling Shi Dao. From then on the enemy raided the western frontier almost daily, and the border population was plunged into misery.
63
三十一年春，敵二千騎寇大同，指揮王恭御之於平川墩，戰死。 夏，東入遼塞，圍百戶常祿，指揮姚大謨、劉棟、劉啟基等於三道氵冓，四人皆戰沒。 備御指揮王相赴援，大戰於寺兒山，殺傷相當，敵捨去。 千戶葉廷瑞率百人助相。 明日，相裹創復邀敵於蠟黎山，殊死鬥，矢竭，遂與麾下將士三百人皆死之。 廷瑞被創死復甦，敵亦引退。 其年，凡四犯大同，三犯遼陽，一犯寧夏。 明年春，犯宣府及延綏。 夏，犯甘肅及大同。 守將御之輒敗。 秋，俺答覆大舉入寇，下渾源、靈丘、廣昌，急攻插箭、浮圖等峪。 固原游擊陳鳳、寧夏游擊硃玉率兵赴援，大戰卻之。 敵分兵東犯蔚，西掠代、繁畤。 已，駐鹿阝、延二十日，延慶諸城屠掠幾遍，乃移營中部，以瞰涇、原，會久雨乃去。 時小王子亦乘隙為寇，犯宣府赤城。 未幾，俺答覆以萬騎入大同，縱掠至八角堡。 巡撫趙時春御之，遇敵於大蟲嶺，總兵李淶戰死，軍覆，時春僅以身免。
In the spring of the thirty-first year, two thousand enemy horsemen raided Datong. Commander Wang Gong met them at Pingchuan Fort and was killed in battle. In summer they entered the Liaodong frontier from the east and besieged Centurion Chang Lu along with Commanders Yao Damo, Liu Dong, and Liu Qiji at Sandao Gou. All four died fighting. Defense Commander Wang Xiang marched to relieve them and fought a great battle at Si'er Mountain. Casualties were roughly equal on both sides, and the enemy broke off and withdrew. Centurion Ye Tingrui led a hundred men to reinforce Wang Xiang. The next day Wang Xiang, binding his wounds, again engaged the enemy at Wali Mountain in a fight to the death. When his arrows were spent, he and all three hundred officers and men under his command perished. Ye Tingrui was wounded so severely that he appeared dead, then revived; the enemy also withdrew. That year they raided Datong four times, Liaoyang three times, and Ningxia once. The following spring they raided Xuanfu and Yan'an. In summer they raided Gansu and Datong. Whenever defending generals met them, they were defeated. In autumn Altan launched another major invasion, descending on Hunyuan, Lingqiu, and Guangchang and pressing hard against the passes at Chajian, Futu, and elsewhere. Mobile corps commanders Chen Feng of Guyuan and Zhu Yu of Ningxia led relief troops and repelled the enemy in a great battle. The enemy divided their forces, raiding Yu in the east and plundering Dai and Fanzhi in the west. They then encamped at Luye and Yan for twenty days, slaughtering and plundering nearly every town in Yanqing. Afterward they shifted camp to the central regions to threaten Jingzhou and Guyuan, and withdrew only when heavy rains set in. At the same time the Lesser Prince seized the opening to raid as well, striking Chicheng in Xuanfu. Before long Altan again entered Datong with ten thousand horsemen and plundered freely as far as Bajiao Fort. Grand Coordinator Zhao Shichun went to meet them and encountered the enemy at Dachong Ridge. Supreme Commander Li Cai was killed in battle, the army was destroyed, and Zhao Shichun barely escaped with his life.
64
三十三年春，入宣府柴溝堡。 夏，復犯寧夏，大同總兵岳懋中伏死。 秋，攻薊鎮牆，百道並進。 警報日數十至，京師戒嚴。 總督楊博悉力拒守，募死士夜砍其營，敵驚擾乃遁。 明年數犯宣、薊，參將趙傾葵、李光啟、丁碧先後戰死。 朝廷再下賞格，購俺答首，賜萬金，爵伯； 獲丘富、周原者三百金，授三品武階。 時富等在敵，招集亡命，居豐州，築城自衛，構宮殿，墾水田，號曰板升。 板升，華言屋也。 趙全教敵，益習攻戰事。 俺答愛之甚，每入寇必置酒全所問計。
In the spring of the thirty-third year they entered Chaigou Fort in Xuanfu. In summer they raided Ningxia again. Datong supreme commander Yue Maozhong was killed in an ambush. In autumn they attacked the walls of Jizhou, advancing along a hundred routes at once. Alarm reports arrived by the dozens each day, and the capital was placed under martial alert. Governor-General Yang Bo defended with all his strength, recruited dare-to-die men to strike the enemy camps by night, and the startled enemy broke off in disorder and fled. The following year they raided Xuanfu and Jizhou several times. Regimental commanders Zhao Qingkui, Li Guangqi, and Ding Bi were killed in battle one after another. The court again posted reward notices offering ten thousand in gold and a marquisate for Altan Khan's head. For capturing Qiu Fu and Zhou Yuan, the reward was three hundred taels of gold and appointment to the third military rank. Qiu Fu and the others were then living among the Tartars. They gathered fugitives, settled at Fengzhou, built walled towns for self-defense, erected palaces, opened irrigated fields, and called the settlements bansheng. Bansheng meant "house" in Chinese. Zhao Quan instructed the Tartars, and they grew increasingly adept at siege and battle. Altan favored him greatly. Before every raid he would feast at Zhao Quan's home and ask his advice.
65
三十五年夏，敵三萬騎犯宣府。 游擊張紘迎戰，敗死。 冬，掠大同邊，繼掠陝西環、慶諸處，守將孫朝、袁正等卻之。 其年，土蠻再犯遼東。
In the summer of the thirty-fifth year, thirty thousand enemy horsemen raided Xuanfu. Mobile corps commander Zhang Hong met them in battle and was defeated and killed. In winter they plundered the Datong frontier and then raided Huanzhou, Qingyang, and other parts of Shaanxi. Defending generals Sun Chao and Yuan Zheng drove them back. That year Tumen Khan again raided Liaodong.
66
明年，敵以二萬騎分掠大同邊，殺守備唐天祿、把總汪淵。 俺答弟老把都復擁眾數萬入河流口，犯永平及遷安，副總兵蔣承勳力戰死。 夏，突犯宣府馬尾梁，參將祁勉戰死。 秋，復入大同右衛境，攻毀七十餘堡，所殺擄甚眾。 冬，俺答子辛愛有妾曰桃松寨，私部目收令哥，懼誅來降。 總督楊順自詡為奇功，致之闕下。 辛愛來索不得，乃縱掠大同諸墩堡，圍右衛數匝。 順懼，乃詭言敵願易我以趙全、丘富。 本兵許論以為便，乃遣桃松寨夜逸出塞，紿之西走，陰告辛愛，辛愛執而戮之。 敵狎知順無能，圍右衛益急，更分兵犯宣、薊鎮。 西鄙震動，右衛烽火斷絕者六閱月。 大學士嚴嵩與許論議，欲棄右衛。 帝不聽，詔諸臣發兵措餉，而以兵部侍郎江東代順。 時故將尚表以饋餉入圍城，悉力捍禦，粟盡食牛馬，徹屋為薪，士卒無變志。 表時出兵突戰，獲俺答孫及婿與其部將各一人。 會帝所遣侍郎江東及巡撫楊選、總兵張承勳等各嚴兵進，圍乃解。 復掠永昌、涼州及宣府赤城，圍甘州十四日始退。 土蠻亦數寇遼東。
The following year the enemy sent twenty thousand horsemen in separate columns to plunder the Datong frontier, killing Defense Commander Tang Tianlu and Company Commander Wang Yuan. Altan's younger brother La Batu again led tens of thousands through Heliukou and struck Yongping and Qian'an. Vice supreme commander Jiang Chengxun fought fiercely and was killed. In summer they suddenly struck Maweiliang in Xuanfu. Regimental commander Qi Mian was killed in battle. In autumn they again entered Datong Right Guard territory, attacked and destroyed more than seventy forts, and killed or captured a great many people. In winter Altan's son Xing'ai had a concubine named Taosongzhai who had secretly taken up with the tribal officer Shoulinge. Fearing punishment, she defected to the Ming. Governor-General Yang Shun touted this as a singular achievement and had her brought to the imperial court. Xing'ai came to demand her return but was refused. He then plundered Datong's forts and beacon towers and surrounded Right Guard many times over. Yang Shun, afraid, falsely claimed the enemy wished to exchange her for Zhao Quan and Qiu Fu. Minister of War Xu Lun thought this expedient. They sent Taosongzhai to slip out of the frontier by night, tricked her into fleeing west, secretly informed Xing'ai, and Xing'ai seized and executed her. Having grown familiar with Yang Shun's incompetence, the enemy pressed the siege of Right Guard more urgently and sent separate columns to raid Xuanfu and Jizhou. The western frontier was thrown into turmoil. Beacon fires from Right Guard went unanswered for six months. Grand Secretary Yan Song and Xu Lun deliberated and proposed abandoning Right Guard. The emperor refused. He ordered the ministers to dispatch troops and arrange supplies, and replaced Yang Shun with Vice Minister of War Jiang Dong. At that time the veteran general Shang Biao, bringing provisions into the besieged city, defended with all his strength. When grain ran out they ate cattle and horses, tore down houses for firewood, and the soldiers never wavered. From time to time Shang Biao sallied forth and captured Altan's grandson, his son-in-law, and one tribal general apiece. Just then Vice Minister Jiang Dong, dispatched by the emperor, together with Grand Coordinator Yang Xuan, Supreme Commander Zhang Chengxun, and others, each advanced with disciplined troops, and the siege was lifted. The enemy again plundered Yongchang, Liangzhou, and Chicheng in Xuanfu, and besieged Ganzhou for fourteen days before withdrawing. Tumen Khan also raided Liaodong repeatedly.
67
三十八年春，老把都、辛愛謀大舉入犯，駐會州，使其諜詭稱東下。 總督王忬不能察，遽分兵而東，號令數易，敵遂乘間入薊鎮潘家口，忬得罪。 夏，犯大同，轉掠宣府東西二城，駐內地旬日，會久雨乃退。
In the spring of the thirty-eighth year, La Batu and Xing'ai planned a major invasion, encamped at Huizhou, and had their spies falsely claim they were moving east. Governor-General Wang Xu failed to see through the ruse, hastily divided his troops and moved east, changed orders repeatedly, and the enemy seized the opening to enter Panjiakou in Jizhou. Wang Xu was punished. In summer they raided Datong, then turned to plunder the eastern and western cities of Xuanfu. They encamped inside the frontier for ten days and withdrew only when heavy rains set in.
68
三十九年，敵聚眾喜峰口外，窺犯薊鎮。 大同總兵劉漢出搗其帳於灰河，敵稍遠徙。 秋，漢復與參將王孟夏等搗豐州，擒斬一百五十人，焚板升略盡。 是歲，寇大同、延綏、薊、遼邊無虛日。 明年春，敵自河西踏冰入寇，守備王世臣、千戶李虎戰死。 秋，犯宣府及居庸。 冬，掠陝西、寧夏塞。 已，復分兵而東，陷蓋州。
In the thirty-ninth year the enemy gathered troops outside Xifeng Pass, watching for an opportunity to strike Jizhou. Datong supreme commander Liu Han raided their camp at Huihe, and the enemy withdrew farther away. In autumn Liu Han again, with regimental commander Wang Mengxia and others, raided Fengzhou, capturing and beheading one hundred fifty men and burning the bansheng settlements nearly to completion. That year they raided the borders of Datong, Yan'an, Jizhou, and Liaodong without a single idle day. The following spring the enemy crossed the frozen Hexi frontier to raid. Defense Commander Wang Shichen and Centurion Li Hu were killed in battle. In autumn they raided Xuanfu and Juyong. In winter they plundered the frontiers of Shaanxi and Ningxia. Afterward they again divided their forces and moved east, capturing Gaizhou.
69
四十一年夏，土蠻入撫順，為總兵黑春所敗。 冬，復攻鳳凰城，春力戰二日夜，死之。 海、金殺掠尤甚。 冬，俺答數犯山西、寧夏塞。 延綏總兵趙岢分部銳卒，令裨將李希靖等東出神木堡，搗敵帳於半坡山，徐執中等西出定邊營，擊敵騎於荍麥湖，皆勝之，斬一百十九級。
In the summer of the forty-first year Tumen Khan entered Fushun and was defeated by supreme commander Hei Chun. In winter they again attacked Fenghuang Fort. Hei Chun fought fiercely for two days and nights and was killed. The killing and plundering in Hai and Jin were especially severe. In winter Altan repeatedly raided the frontiers of Shanxi and Ningxia. Yan'an supreme commander Zhao Ke deployed picked troops in separate columns. He sent lieutenant general Li Xijing and others east from Shenmu Fort to raid the enemy camp at Banpo Mountain, while Xu Zhizhong and others marched west from Dingbian Camp to strike enemy horsemen at Qiaomai Lake. Both columns were victorious, taking one hundred nineteen heads.
70
四十二年春，敵入宣府滴水崖，劉漢卻之。 敵遂引而東，數犯遼塞。 秋，總兵楊照敗死。 時薊遼總督楊選囚縶三衛長通罕，令其諸子更迭為質。 通罕者，辛愛妻父也，冀以牽制辛愛，三衛皆怨。 冬，大掠順義、三河。 諸將趙溱、孫臏戰死，京師戒嚴。 大同總兵姜應熊御之於密雲，敗之，敵退。 詔誅選。 明年，土蠻入遼東，都御史劉燾上諸將守禦功，言海水暴漲，敵騎多沒者。 帝曰：「海若效靈。 」下有司祭告，燾等皆有賞。 冬，敵犯狹西，大掠板橋、響閘兒諸處。
In the spring of the forty-second year the enemy entered Dishui Cliff in Xuanfu. Liu Han repelled them. The enemy then withdrew east and repeatedly raided the Liaodong frontier. In autumn supreme commander Yang Zhao was defeated and killed. At that time Ji-Liao governor-general Yang Xuan imprisoned the Three Guards chieftain Tonghan and required his sons to serve in rotation as hostages. Tonghan was Xing'ai's father-in-law. The Ming hoped this would restrain Xing'ai, but all Three Guards resented the move. In winter they plundered heavily in Shunyi and Sanhe. Generals Zhao Qin and Sun Bin were killed in battle, and the capital was placed under martial alert. Datong supreme commander Jiang Yingxiong met them at Miyun and defeated them, and the enemy withdrew. An edict ordered Yang Xuan's execution. The following year Tumen Khan entered Liaodong. Censor-in-Chief Liu Tao submitted reports on the generals' defensive achievements, noting that the sea waters rose violently and many enemy horsemen were drowned. The emperor said: "The sea god has shown his power. " He ordered the officials to perform sacrificial rites and report back, and Liu Tao and the others all received rewards. In winter the enemy raided Shaanxi and plundered heavily at Banqiao, Xiang'er, and other places.
71
四十四年春，犯遼東寧前小團山，參將線補袞、游擊楊維籓死之。 夏，犯肅州，總兵劉承業御之，再戰皆捷。 秋，俺答子黃台吉帥輕騎，自宣府洗馬林突入，散掠內地。 把總姜汝棟以銳卒二百伏暗莊堡，猝遇台吉，搏之。 台吉墮馬，為所部奪去。 台吉受傷，越日始蘇。 明年，俺答屢犯東西諸塞。 夏，清河守備郎得功扼之張能峪口，勝之。 冬，大同參將崔世榮禦敵於樊皮嶺，及子大朝、大賓俱戰死。 時丘富死，趙全在敵中益用事，尊俺答為帝，治宮殿。 期日上棟，忽大風，棟墜傷數人。 俺答懼，不敢復居。 兵部侍郎譚綸在薊鎮善治兵，全乃說俺答無輕犯薊，大同兵弱，可以逞。
In the spring of the forty-fourth year they raided Xiaotuanshan in Ningqian, Liaodong. Regimental commander Xian Bugun and mobile corps commander Yang Weifan were killed. In summer they raided Suzhou. Supreme commander Liu Chengye met them and won two battles in succession. In autumn Altan's son Hongtaiji led light horsemen and suddenly entered from Ximolin in Xuanfu, scattering to plunder the interior. Company commander Jiang Rudong, with two hundred picked troops, lay in ambush at Anzhuang Fort, suddenly encountered Hongtaiji, and grappled with him. Huangtaiji was thrown from his horse and borne away by his own men. Huangtaiji was badly wounded and did not come to until the following day. The following year Altan struck the eastern and western frontier passes again and again. That summer Defense Commander Lang Degong of Qinghe held them at Zhangnengyukou and won the day. That winter Datong Assistant Commander Cui Shirong met the enemy at Fanpiling. He and his sons Dazhao and Dabin were all killed in action. By then Qiu Fu was dead. Zhao Quan wielded still greater influence among the enemy, treating Altan as an emperor and raising palaces for him. On the day the ridgepole was to be raised, a sudden gale struck.
