The beam crashed down and injured several men. Altan was terrified and would not live there again. Vice Minister of War Tan Lun held Jizhou and was adept at drilling troops. Zhao Quan then urged Altan not to lightly strike Jizhou—Datong's defenses were weak, and there he could raid at will.
72
二年，敵犯柴溝，守備韓尚忠戰死。 時兵部侍郎王崇古鎮西邊，總兵李成梁守遼東，數以兵邀擊於塞外。 敵知有備，入寇稍稀。
In the second year the enemy struck Chaigou. Defense Commander Han Shangzhong was killed in action. Vice Minister of War Wang Chonggu then held the western frontier and Supreme Commander Li Chengliang guarded Liaodong. Both repeatedly waylaid the enemy beyond the passes. Finding the frontier well prepared, the enemy raided less often.
73
四年秋，黃台吉寇錦州，總兵王治道、參將郎得功以十餘騎入敵死。 冬，俺答有孫曰把漢那吉者，俺答第三子鐵背台吉子也，幼孤，育於俺答妻所。 既長，娶婦比吉。 把漢復聘襖兒都司女，即俺答外孫女，貌美，俺答奪之。 把漢恚，遂率其屬阿力哥等十人來降。 大同巡撫方逢時受之，以告總督王崇古。 崇古上言：「把漢來歸，非擁眾內附者比，宜給官爵，豐館餼，飭輿馬，以示俺答。 俺答急，則使縛送板升諸叛人； 不聽，即脅誅把漢牽沮之； 又不然，因而撫納，如漢置屬國居烏桓故事，使招其故部，徙近塞。 俺答老且死，黃台吉立，則令把漢還，以其眾與台吉抗，我按兵助之。 」詔可，授把漢指揮使，阿力哥正千戶。
In the autumn of the fourth year Huangtaiji raided Jinzhou. Supreme Commander Wang Zhidao and Assistant Commander Lang Degong led a dozen horsemen straight into the enemy and were killed. That winter Altan had a grandson named Bahananji, the son of his third son Tiebei Huangtaiji. Orphaned young, he was raised in Altan's wife's household. When he came of age he married a woman named Biji. Bahan had also betrothed a daughter of the A'er Dusi, Altan's own granddaughter, renowned for her beauty. Altan took her for himself. Furious, Bahan led his followers Ailege and nine others to defect to the Ming. Datong Grand Coordinator Fang Fengshi received them and reported to Governor Wang Chonggu. Wang Chonggu memorialized: "Bahan's defection is not the usual case of a chieftain leading his horde inward. We should grant him office and rank, generous lodging and provisions, and proper mounts and carriages—so Altan may see how he is treated. If Altan grows desperate, make him bind and deliver the Bansheng defectors; if he refuses, threaten to execute Bahan to restrain him; or, if not that, settle him as the Han once settled dependent states among the Wuhuan—let him summon his old following and move them near the passes. When Altan grows old and dies and Huangtaiji succeeds, send Bahan back. With his followers he can stand against Huangtaiji, and we can hold our armies in reserve to support him. " The emperor approved. Bahan was appointed Commander, and Ailege Regular Company Commander.
74
俺答方西掠吐番，聞之亟引還，約諸部入犯，崇古檄諸道嚴兵御之。 敵使來請命，崇古遣譯者鮑崇德往，言朝廷待把漢甚厚，第能縛板升諸叛人趙全等，旦送至，把漢即夕返矣。 俺答大喜，屏人語曰：「我不為亂，亂由全等。 若天子幸封我為王，長北方諸部，孰敢為患？ 即死，吾孫當襲封，彼衣食中國，忍倍德乎？ 」乃益發使與崇德來乞封，且請輸馬，與中國鐵鍋、布帛互市，隨執趙全、李自馨等數人來獻。 崇古乃以帝命遣把漢歸，把漢猶戀戀，感泣再拜去。 俺答得孫大喜，上表謝。
Altan was raiding Tibet in the west. Hearing the news he hurried back, called the tribes to arms, and Wang Chonggu ordered every circuit to stand ready. The enemy sent envoys to sue for peace. Wang Chonggu sent the interpreter Bao Chongde, who told them the court had treated Bahan with great honor—and that if Altan would bind the Bansheng defectors Zhao Quan and the rest and deliver them by dawn, Bahan would return that same night. Altan was overjoyed. Sending the others away, he said privately, "I do not make trouble—trouble comes from Quan and his followers. If the Son of Heaven will deign to ennoble me king over the northern tribes, who would dare raise trouble? When I die, my grandson will inherit the title. Fed and clothed by China, how could he betray its grace? " He then sent more envoys with Chongde to beg enfeoffment, to offer horses in exchange for iron pots, cloth, and silk at mutual markets, and at the same time delivered Zhao Quan, Li Zixin, and several others bound as tribute. By imperial command Wang Chonggu sent Bahan back. Bahan lingered still, weeping as he bowed twice and took his leave. Altan, having recovered his grandson, was overjoyed and submitted a memorial of thanks.
75
崇古因上言：「朝廷若允俺答封貢，諸邊有數年之安，可乘時修備。 設敵背盟，吾以數年蓄養之財力，從事戰守，愈於終歲奔命，自救不暇者矣。 」復條八事以請。 一，議封號官爵。 諸部行輩，俺答為尊，宜錫以王號，給印信。 其大枝如老把都、黃台吉及吉囊長子吉能等，俱宜授以都督。 弟侄子孫如兀慎打兒漢等四十六枝，授以指揮。 其俺答諸婿十餘枝，授以千戶。 一，定貢額。 每歲一入貢，俺答馬十匹，使十人。 老把都、吉能、黃台吉八匹，使四人。 諸部長各以部落大小為差，大者四匹，小者二匹，使各二人。 通計歲貢馬不得過五百匹，使不得過百五十人。 馬分三等，上駟三十進御，余給價有差，老瘠者不入。 其使，歲許六十人進京，余待境上。 使還，聽以馬價市繒布諸物。 給酬賞，其賞額視三衛及西蕃諸國。 一，議貢期、貢道。 以春月及萬壽聖節四方來同之會，使人，馬匹及表文自大同左衛驗入，給犒賞。 駐邊者，分送各城撫鎮驗賞。 入京者，押送自居庸關入。 一，立互市。 其規如弘治初，北部三貢例。 蕃以金、銀、牛馬、皮張、馬尾等物，商販以緞紬、布匹、釜鍋等物。 開市日，來者以三百人駐邊外，宣府應於萬全右衛、張家口邊外，山西應於水泉營邊外。 一，議撫賞。 守市兵人布二匹，部長緞二匹、紬二匹。 以好至邊者，酌來使大小，量加賞犒。 一，議歸降。 通貢後，降者不分有罪無罪，免收納。 其華人被擄歸正者，查別無竊盜，乃許入。 一，審經權。 一，戒狡飾。
Wang Chonggu therefore memorialized: "If the court grants Altan enfeoffment and tribute, the frontiers will know several years of peace, and we can use the interval to strengthen our defenses. Should they break faith, we can fight and hold with several years' accumulated wealth and strength—far better than racing year-round in emergency, barely able to save ourselves. " He also set forth eight points in his request. First, settle titles and official ranks. Among the tribes Altan stands first in seniority; he should receive a princely title and an official seal. Major branches such as Laobadou, Huangtaiji, and Jinang's eldest son Jineng should all be appointed Regional Commanders. Younger brothers, nephews, and grandsons—forty-six branches such as Wushen Da'erhan—should receive appointments as Commanders. Altan's dozen-odd sons-in-law and their branches should be appointed Company Commanders. Second, fix the tribute quota. Once each year they would tribute: Altan ten horses and ten envoys. Laobadou, Jineng, and Huangtaiji eight horses and four envoys. Each tribal chief according to the size of his following: the larger four horses, the smaller two, each with two envoys. In all, yearly tribute horses must not exceed five hundred, and envoys one hundred fifty. Horses would be graded in three classes: the finest thirty presented to the throne, the rest purchased at set prices, and old or lean animals rejected. Of the envoys, sixty each year would be permitted to enter the capital; the rest would wait at the border. On their return, envoys might use the horse price to buy silk, cloth, and other goods. Rewards would be granted on the same scale as for the Three Guards and the western Tibetan states. Third, set tribute seasons and routes. In spring and at the Emperor's Longevity Festival, when envoys from all quarters assemble, horses, envoys, and memorials would enter through inspection at Datong Left Guard and receive frontier rewards. Those remaining at the frontier would be sent in groups to the various garrison cities for inspection and reward by the grand coordinators and supreme commanders. Those bound for the capital would be escorted in through Juyong Pass. Fourth, establish mutual markets. The regulations would follow the early Hongzhi precedent for the northern tribute missions. The tribes would bring gold, silver, cattle, horses, hides, and horsehair; merchants would bring satin, silk, cloth, and iron pots. On market days three hundred men would be stationed outside the passes: Xuanfu at Wanquan Right Guard and Zhangjiakou, Shanxi at Shuiquanying. Fifth, set frontier gifts and rewards. Market guards would receive two bolts of cloth each; tribal chiefs two bolts of satin and two of silk each. For those coming in goodwill to the frontier, additional rewards would be granted according to the envoys' rank. Sixth, settle policy on those who surrender. Once tribute relations were established, those who surrendered would be received regardless of guilt. Chinese captives returning to allegiance would be admitted only after inquiry found no record of theft. Seventh, weigh principle against expediency. Eighth, guard against deceit.
76
疏入，下廷臣議。 帝終從崇古言，詔封俺答為順義王，賜紅蟒衣一襲； 昆都力哈、黃台吉授都督同知，各賜紅獅子衣一襲、彩幣四表裡； 賓兔台吉等十人，授指揮同知； 那木兒台吉等十九人，授指揮僉事； 打兒漢台吉等十八人，授正千戶； 阿拜台吉等十二人，授副千戶； 恰台吉等二人，授百戶。 昆都力哈，即老把都也。 兵部采崇古議，定市令。 秋市成，凡得馬五百餘匹，賜俺答等彩幣有差。 西部吉能及其侄切盡等亦請市，詔予市紅山墩暨清水營。 市成，亦封吉能為都督同知。 已而俺答請金字經及剌麻僧，詔給之。 崇古復請玉印，詔予鍍金銀印。 俺答老佞佛，復請於海南建寺，詔賜寺額仰華。 俺答常遠處青山，二子，曰賓兔，居松山，直蘭州之北，曰丙兔，居西海，直河州之西，並求互市，多桀驁。 俺答諭之，亦漸馴。
When the memorial arrived, it was sent down for discussion among court officials. The emperor at last accepted Wang Chonggu's counsel and decreed that Altan be enfeoffed as Prince of Shun Righteousness, granting him one robe of red python silk; Kunuliha and Huangtaiji were appointed Vice Regional Commanders, each granted a robe of red lion pattern and four layers of colored silks; Bintu Huangtaiji and ten others were appointed Assistant Regional Commanders; Namier Huangtaiji and nineteen others were appointed Junior Assistant Regional Commanders; Da'erhan Huangtaiji and eighteen others were appointed Regular Company Commanders; Abai Huangtaiji and twelve others were appointed Vice Company Commanders; Qia Huangtaiji and two others were appointed Platoon Commanders. Kunuliha was Laobadou. The Ministry of War adopted Wang Chonggu's proposals and fixed the market regulations. The autumn market opened. More than five hundred horses were obtained in all, and Altan and the others received graded gifts of colored silk. Jineng of the western tribes and his nephew Qiejin also requested markets; an edict granted markets at Hongshandun and Qingshuiying. Once the markets were established, Jineng was also enfeoffed as Vice Regional Commander. Soon afterward Altan requested a gold-letter sutra and lamas; an edict granted both. Wang Chonggu again requested a jade seal; an edict granted a gold-plated silver seal instead. Altan in his old age was devoted to Buddhism and again asked to build a temple south of the sea; an edict granted the temple the name Yanghua. Altan often stayed far off in the green mountains. He had two sons: Bintu, who lived at Songshan directly north of Lanzhou, and Bingtu, who lived at the Western Sea directly west of Hezhou. Both sought mutual markets and were often unruly. Altan admonished them, and they gradually grew tame.
77
萬曆六年，成梁率游擊秦得倚等擊敵於東昌堡，斬部長九人，余級八百八十四，總督梁夢龍以聞。 帝大悅，祭告郊廟，御皇極門宣捷。
In the sixth year of Wanli, Li Chengliang led Guerrilla Commander Qin Deyi and others against the enemy at Dongchang Fortress, killing nine tribal chiefs and eight hundred eighty-four others in all. Governor Liang Menglong reported the victory. The emperor was greatly pleased. He offered sacrifice at the suburban altars and proclaimed the victory at the Gate of Imperial Supremacy.
78
七年冬，土蠻四萬騎入錦川營。 夢龍、成梁及總兵戚繼光等已預受大學士張居正方略，併力備御，敵始退。 自是敵數入，成梁等數敗之，輒斬其巨魁，又時襲擊於塞外，多所斬獲。 敵畏之，少戢，成梁遂以功封寧遠伯。
In the winter of the seventh year Tumen entered with forty thousand horsemen at Jinchuanying. Liang Menglong, Li Chengliang, and Supreme Commander Qi Jiguang had already received Grand Secretary Zhang Juzheng's strategy and combined forces to defend. The enemy then withdrew. From then on the enemy raided repeatedly. Li Chengliang and his colleagues defeated them again and again, often killing their great chiefs, and also struck beyond the passes from time to time, taking many heads and captives. The enemy feared them and pulled back somewhat. Li Chengliang was therefore enfeoffed as Marquis of Ningyuan for his achievements.
79
俺答既就市，事朝廷甚謹。 部下卒有掠奪邊氓者，必罰治之，且稽首謝罪，朝廷亦厚加賞賚。 十年春，俺答死，帝特賜祭七壇、綵緞十二表裡、布百匹，示優恤。 其妻哈屯率子黃台吉等，上表進馬謝，復賜幣布有差。 封黃台吉為順義王，改名乞慶哈。 立三歲而死，朝廷給恤典如例。
Once Altan had entered the markets, he served the court with scrupulous care. If his men raided frontier subjects he invariably punished them and kowtowed in apology. The court richly rewarded him in turn. In the spring of the tenth year Altan died. The emperor specially granted seven sacrificial altars, twelve layers of colored silks, and one hundred bolts of cloth in special condolence. His wife Hatun led her son Huangtaiji and the others in submitting a memorial and offering horses in thanks. They received graded gifts of silk and cloth again. Huangtaiji was enfeoffed as Prince of Shun Righteousness and renamed Qiqingha. Three years after his succession he died, and the court granted him the full condolence rites due his rank.
80
十五年春，子撦力克嗣。 其妻三娘子，故俺答所奪之外孫女而為婦者也，歷配三王，主兵柄，為中國守邊保塞，眾畏服之，乃敕封為忠順夫人，自宣大至甘肅不用兵者二十年。 及撦力克西行遠邊，而套部莊禿賴等據水塘，卜失兔、火落赤等據莽剌、捏工兩川，數犯甘、涼、洮、氓、西寧間。 他部落亡慮數十種，出沒塞下，順逆不常。 帝惡之，十九年詔並停撦力克市賞。 已而撦力克叩邊輸服，率眾東歸，獨莊禿賴、卜失兔等寇抄如故。 其年冬，別部明安、土昧分犯榆林邊，總兵杜桐御之，斬獲五百人，殺明安。
In the spring of the fifteenth year his son Chelik succeeded. His wife the Third Lady—originally Altan's granddaughter, seized and made his wife—had been married to three khans in succession. She held military power, guarded the frontier and kept the passes for China, and all feared and obeyed her. She was therefore enfeoffed as Lady of Loyal Submission, and from Xuanfu and Datong to Gansu the frontier knew twenty years without war. When Chelik marched far to the western frontier, the Ordos chieftain Zhuang Tulai held Shuitang while Bushitu, Huoluochi, and others held the Mangla and Nie'gong valleys, repeatedly striking the regions between Gansu, Liangzhou, Tao, Min, and Xining. Other tribes, perhaps several dozen in all, appeared and vanished along the frontier, shifting between compliance and hostility without fixed pattern. The emperor was disgusted. In the nineteenth year an edict suspended Chelik's markets and rewards. Before long Chelik came to the frontier to submit, led his followers back east, while Zhuang Tulai, Bushitu, and the others kept raiding and pillaging as before. That winter Ming An and Tumei of another division separately struck the Yulin frontier. Regional commander Du Tong met them in battle, killed or captured five hundred men, and slew Ming An.
81
二十年，寧夏叛將哱拜等勾卜失兔、莊禿賴等，大舉入寇，總兵李如松擊敗之。 二十二年，延綏巡撫李春光奏：「套部納款已久，自明安被戮而寇恨深，西夏黨逆而貢市絕，延鎮連年多事。 今東西各部皆乞款，而卜失兔挾私叵測，邊長兵寡，制御為難。 宜察敵情，審時勢。 敵入犯則血戰，偶或小失，應寬吏議。 倘敵真心效順，相機議撫，不可忘戰備也。 」帝命兵部傳飭各邊。 秋，卜失兔入固原，游擊史見戰死。 延綏總兵麻貴御之，閱月始退。 全陝震動。 其年，東部炒花犯鎮武堡，總兵董一元與戰，大破之。 明年春，松部宰僧等犯陝西，總督葉夢熊督卻之。 秋，海部永邵卜犯西寧，總督三邊李旼檄參將達雲、游擊白澤暨馬其撒、卜爾加諸屬番，設伏邀擊，大敗之，斬六百八十三級。 捷聞，帝大悅，且以屬番效命，追敘前總制鄭雒功，賞賚並及雒。
In the twentieth year the Ningxia rebel Pabo and his allies incited Bushitu, Zhuang Tulai, and others to mount a major invasion. Regional commander Li Rusong defeated them. In the twenty-second year Yansui grand coordinator Li Chunguang memorialized: "The Ordos tribes have long pledged submission. Since Ming An was executed their thirst for vengeance runs deep; with Western Xia factions in rebellion the tribute markets have closed, and Yan and the garrisons have been embroiled year after year. Now the eastern and western divisions are all petitioning to submit, but Bushitu's private designs are impossible to read. The frontier is long, troops are few, and keeping control is hard. We should read the enemy's intentions and weigh the situation carefully. When the enemy invades we should fight without quarter; if commanders suffer the occasional minor setback, they should be spared harsh censure. If the enemy genuinely seeks to submit, we can consider pacification as opportunity allows—but we must never neglect our defenses. " The emperor ordered the Ministry of War to relay instructions to all frontier commands. That autumn Bushitu entered Guyuan. Guerrilla commander Shi Jian was killed in action. Yansui regional commander Ma Gui held him off, and only after a full month did Bushitu withdraw. All of Shaanxi was alarmed. That year Chao Hua of the eastern division attacked Zhenwu Fort. Regional commander Dong Yiyuan met him in battle and routed him. The following spring Zaiseng and other leaders of the Song division invaded Shaanxi. Grand secretary Ye Mengxiong directed the defense and drove them back. That autumn Yong Shaobu of the Hai division struck at Xining. Three Frontiers grand secretary Li Min ordered vice general Da Yun, guerrilla commander Bai Ze, and the Fan chieftains Maqisa, Bu'erjia, and their followers to lay ambush and intercept. They won a crushing victory and took six hundred eighty-three heads. When word of the victory arrived the emperor was delighted. Because the subordinate Fan had fought loyally, he also retrospectively recognized the former grand coordinator Zheng Luo's achievement, and rewards were extended to Luo as well.
82
二十四年春，總督李釐以勁兵分三道出塞，襲卜失兔營，共斬四百九級，獲馬畜器械數千。 火落赤部眾復窺伺洮州，釐遣參將周國柱等擊之於莽剌川腦，斬一百三十六級。 秋，著力兔、阿赤兔、火落赤等合謀犯西邊，炒花亦擁眾犯廣寧，守將皆嚴兵卻之。 二十五年秋，海部寇甘鎮，官軍擊走之。 冬，炒花糾土蠻諸部寇遼東，殺掠無算。 明年夏，復寇遼東，總兵李如松遠出搗巢，死之。 冬，釐等分道出襲火落赤等於松山，走之，復其地。
In the spring of the twenty-fourth year grand secretary Li Li led crack troops in three columns beyond the frontier, struck Bushitu's camp, took four hundred nine heads, and seized thousands of horses, livestock, and weapons. Huoluochi's followers again probed Taozhou. Li dispatched vice general Zhou Guozhu and others to meet them at the headwaters of the Mangla River and took one hundred thirty-six heads. That autumn Zhuli Tu, Achitu, Huoluochi, and others joined in a coordinated strike on the western frontier. Chao Hua also led a large force against Guangning. The garrison commanders held them off with disciplined troops. In the autumn of the twenty-fifth year the Hai division raided the Gansu garrison. Government troops beat them back. That winter Chao Hua rallied the Tuman and other tribes to raid Liaodong, killing and plundering without measure. The following summer they raided Liaodong again. Regional commander Li Rusong led a deep strike against their camp and was killed. That winter Li and his colleagues marched in separate columns to strike Huoluochi and his followers at Songshan, drove them off, and recovered the territory.
83
二十七年詔復撦力克市賞。 時釐等築松山，諸部紛叛，延、寧守臣共擊之，殺獲甲首幾三千。 明年，著力兔、宰僧、莊禿賴等乞通款，不許。 邊臣王見賓等復為請，詔復套部貢市。
In the twenty-seventh year an edict restored Chelik's markets and rewards. While Li and his colleagues were fortifying Songshan, the various tribes rebelled one after another. The garrison commanders of Yan and Ning joined forces against them and killed or captured nearly three thousand armored chiefs. The following year Zhuli Tu, Zaiseng, Zhuang Tulai, and others petitioned to submit. The court refused. Frontier officials Wang Jianbin and others appealed again on their behalf. An edict restored the Ordos tribute markets.
84
三十一年，海部數入陝西塞，兵備副使李自實，總兵蕭如薰、達雲等擊走之。 三十三年夏，東部宰賽誘殺慶雲堡守禦熊鑰，詔革其市賞。
In the thirty-first year the Hai division repeatedly penetrated the Shaanxi frontier. Defense vice commissioner Li Zishi and regional commanders Xiao Ruxun and Da Yun drove them back. In the summer of the thirty-third year Zaisai of the eastern division treacherously killed Qingyun Fort defense commandant Xiong Yao. An edict stripped him of his markets and rewards.
85
三十五年夏，總督徐三畏言：「河套之部與河東之部不同。 東部事統於一，約誓定，歷三十年不變。 套部分四十二枝，各相雄長，卜失兔徒建空名於上。 西則火落赤最狡，要挾最無厭； 中則擺言太以父明安之死，無歲不犯； 東則沙計爭為監市，與炒花朋逞。 西陲搶攘非一日矣。 然眾雖號十萬，分為四十二枝，多者不過二三千騎，少者一二千騎耳。 宜分其勢，納其款，俾先順者獲賞，後至者拒剿。 仍須主戰以張國威。 」時已許宰賽及火落赤諸部復貢市矣。
In the summer of the thirty-fifth year grand secretary Xu Sanwei wrote: "The tribes of the Ordos loop differ from the tribes east of the river. The eastern division answers to a single leader; its covenants were set thirty years ago and have held ever since. The Ordos divides into forty-two branches that vie with one another for supremacy. Bushitu holds only an empty title over them. In the west Huoluochi is the most cunning and insatiable in his demands; in the center Bai Yantai raids every year to avenge his father Ming An's death; in the east Shaji fights to control the markets and runs wild alongside Chao Hua. Turmoil on the western frontier has been building for years. Yet though they are said to number one hundred thousand, split among forty-two branches the largest counts no more than two or three thousand horsemen, the smallest only one or two thousand. We should divide their strength and accept their pledges—reward those who submit first and strike down those who hold back. Even so we must keep war as the main policy to uphold the empire's prestige. " By then Zaisai and Huoluochi's divisions had already been allowed to resume their tribute markets.
86
未幾撦力剋死，未有嗣，忠順夫人率所部仍效貢職。 西部銀定、歹青數擁眾犯東西邊。 延綏部猛克什力亦以挾賞故，常沿邊抄掠。 卜失兔欲婚於忠順，忠順拒之。 其所部素囊台吉、五路台吉等，各不相下，封號久未定。 四十一年，卜失兔始婚於忠順，東、西諸部長皆具狀為請封。 忠順夫人旋卒，詔封卜失兔為順義王，而以把漢比吉素效恭順，封忠義夫人。 卜失兔為撦力克孫，襲封時，已少衰，所制止山、大二鎮外十二部。 其部長五路、素囊及兀慎台吉等，兵力皆與順義埒。 朝廷因宣大總督涂宗浚言，各予升賞如例。
Before long Chelik died without an heir. Lady of Loyal Submission continued to lead her followers in performing tribute duties. Yin Ding and Dai Qing of the western division repeatedly led large forces against both the eastern and western frontiers. Mengkeshili of the Yansui division also frequently raided the frontier, using extorted rewards as a pretext. Bushitu sought to marry Lady of Loyal Submission; she rebuffed him. His subordinates Suonang Taiji, Wulu Taiji, and others each refused to yield to the others, and their titles and enfeoffments had long been unsettled. In the forty-first year Bushitu finally married Lady of Loyal Submission. Chiefs from the eastern and western divisions all filed formal petitions requesting enfeoffments. Lady of Loyal Submission soon died. An edict enfeoffed Bushitu as Prince of Shun Righteousness and, because Bahen Bij had long served loyally, enfeoffed her as Lady of Loyal Righteousness. Bushitu was Chelik's grandson. By the time he inherited the title his power had already waned. He controlled only the twelve divisions outside the Shanshan and Da'er garrisons. His subordinate chiefs Wulu, Suonang, and Wushen Taiji and others commanded forces equal to the Prince's own. At the recommendation of Xuan-Datong grand secretary Tu Zongjun, the court granted each the usual promotions and rewards.
87
其年，炒花糾虎墩兔三犯遼東。 虎墩兔者，居插漢兒地，亦曰插漢兒王子，元裔也。 其祖打來孫始駐牧宣塞外，俺答方強，懼為所並，乃徙帳於遼，收福余雜部，數入掠薊西，四傳至虎墩兔，遂益盛。 明年夏，炒花復合宰賽、暖兔以三萬騎入掠，至平虜、大寧。 既求撫賞，許之。
That year Chao Hua joined with Hudun Tu to raid Liaodong three times. Hudun Tu—also known as the Prince of Cha Han—held the Cha Han lands and was a descendant of the Yuan. His ancestor Dalai Sun first pastured beyond the Xuan frontier. When Altan was at his height he feared annexation and moved his camp to Liaodong, gathered the scattered Fuyu tribes, and repeatedly raided west of Ji. Four generations later Hudun Tu had grown still more powerful. The following summer Chao Hua again joined Zaisai and Nuantu with thirty thousand horsemen in a raid that reached Pinglu and Daning. They then demanded pacification payments, and the court granted them.
88
四十二年，猛克什力寇懷遠及保寧。 延綏總兵官秉忠等破之。 斬二百二十一級。 明年，插部數犯遼東。 已，掠義州，攻陷大安堡，兵民死者甚眾。
In the forty-second year Mengkeshili raided Huaiyuan and Baoning. Yansui regional commander Guan Bingzhong and his colleagues defeated them. Two hundred twenty-one heads were taken. The following year the Cha Han forces repeatedly struck Liaodong. Before long they raided Yizhou, stormed Da'an Fort, and killed a great many soldiers and civilians.
89
四十四年，總兵杜文煥數破套部猛克什力等於延綏邊，火落赤、擺言太及吉能、切盡、歹青、沙計東西諸部皆懼，先後來請貢市。
In the forty-fourth year regional commander Du Wenhuan repeatedly defeated Mengkeshili and other Ordos leaders on the Yansui frontier. Huoluochi, Bai Yantai, Jineng, Qiejin, Dai Qing, Shaji, and other eastern and western chiefs were all alarmed and came one after another to petition for tribute markets.
90
四十六年，我大清兵起，略撫順及開原，插部乘隙擁眾挾賞。 西部阿暈妻滿旦亦以萬騎自石塘路入掠薊鎮白馬關及高家、馮家諸堡。 游擊硃萬良御之，被圍。 羽書日數十至，中外戒嚴。 頃之，滿旦亦叩關乞通貢。
In the forty-sixth year the Great Qing army rose and overran Fushun and Kaiyuan. The Cha Han forces seized the opportunity to gather their followers and extort rewards. Man Dan, wife of western chieftain A Yun, also led ten thousand horsemen through the Shitang route to raid Baima Pass in the Ji garrison and the forts of Gaojia, Fengjia, and others. Guerrilla commander Zhu Wanliang met them in battle and was surrounded. Dozens of urgent dispatches arrived daily, and court and country alike went on high alert. Before long Man Dan also came to the passes to petition for tribute relations.
91
四十七年，大清兵滅宰賽及北關金台什、布羊古等。 金台什孫女為虎墩兔婦，於是薊遼總督文球、巡撫周永春等以利啖之，俾聯結炒花諸部，以捍大清兵，給白金四千。 明年，為泰昌元年，加賞至四萬。 虎乃揚言助中國，邀索無厭。
In the forty-seventh year the Great Qing army destroyed Zaisai and the northern pass chiefs Jintai Shi, Buyanggu, and others. Jintai Shi's granddaughter was Hudun Tu's wife. Jizhou-Liaodong grand secretary Wen Qiu, grand coordinator Zhou Yongchun, and others therefore bribed him to ally with Chao Hua's tribes against the Great Qing army, granting four thousand taels of silver. The following year—the first year of Taichang—the stipend was raised to forty thousand. Hudun Tu then declared he would aid China, but his demands proved insatiable.
92
天啟元年秋，吉能犯延綏邊，榆林總兵杜文煥擊敗之。 明年春，復大掠延安黃花峪，深入六百里，殺掠居民數萬。 三年春，銀定糾眾再掠西邊，官軍擊敗之。 明年春，復謀入故巢，犯松山，為守臣馮任等所敗。 夏，遂糾海西古六台吉等犯甘肅，總兵董繼舒擊之，斬三百餘級。 其年，歹青以領賞嘩於邊，邊人格殺之。 歹青，虎墩兔近屬也，邊臣議歲給償命銀一萬三千有奇，而虎怏怏，益思飏去。 未幾，大清兵襲破炒花，所部皆散亡，半歸於插漢。 時卜失兔益衰，號令不行於諸部，部長干兒罵等歲數犯延綏諸邊。 七慶台吉及敖目比吉、毛乞炭比吉等，亦各擁眾往來窺伺塞下。
In the autumn of the first year of Tianqi Jineng struck the Yansui frontier. Yulin regional commander Du Wenhuan defeated him. The following spring they again raided on a massive scale at Huanghuayu in Yan'an, penetrating six hundred li and killing or plundering tens of thousands of residents. In the spring of the third year Yin Ding rallied his followers for another raid on the western frontier. Government troops defeated them. The following spring they again tried to return to their old grounds and struck at Songshan. Garrison commander Feng Ren and others defeated them. That summer they rallied Haixi Gu Liu Taiji and others to invade Gansu. Regional commander Dong Jishu met them and took more than three hundred heads. That year Dai Qing raised a disturbance at the frontier over his reward payment. Border men killed him on the spot. Dai Qing was a close kinsman of Hudun Tu. Frontier officials proposed an annual blood-price payment of a little over thirteen thousand taels, but Hudun Tu was aggrieved and only grew more eager to break away. Before long the Great Qing army struck and shattered Chao Hua. His followers scattered, and half joined Cha Han. By then Bushitu had weakened further. His orders no longer carried among the tribes, and chiefs such as Gan'erma raided the Yansui frontier year after year. Qiqing Taiji, Aomu Bij, Maoqitan Bij, and others also led their followers back and forth, probing along the frontier.
93
崇禎元年，虎墩兔攻哈喇嗔及白言台吉、卜失兔諸部，皆破之，遂乘勝入犯宣大塞。 秋，帝御平台，召總督王象乾，詢以方略，象乾對言：「御插之道，宜令其自相攻。 今卜失兔西走套內，白台吉挺身免，而哈喇嗔所部多被擄，不足用。 永邵卜最強，約三十萬人，合卜失兔所部並聯絡朵顏三十六家及哈喇嗔餘眾，可以御插漢。 然與其構之，水如撫而用之。 」帝曰：「插漢意不受撫，奈何？ 」對曰：「當從容籠絡。 」帝曰：「如不款何？ 」象乾復密奏，帝善之，命往與督師袁崇煥共計。 象乾至邊，與崇煥議合，皆言西靖而東自寧，虎不款，而東西並急，因定歲予插金八萬一千兩，以示羈縻。 大同巡撫張宗衡上言：「插來宣大，駐新城，去大同僅二百里，三閱月未敢近前，飢餓窮乏，插與我等耳。 插恃撫金為命，兩年不得，資用已竭，食盡馬乏，暴骨成莽。 插之望款不啻望歲，而我遺之金繒、牛羊、茶果、米谷無算，是我適中其欲也。 插炰烋悖慢，耳目不忍睹聞，方急款尚如是。 使插士馬豐飽，其憑陵狂逞，可勝道哉。 」象乾言：「款局垂成而復棼之，既示插以不信，亦非所以為國謀。 」疏入，帝是象乾議，詔宗衡毋得異同。
In the first year of Chongzhen Hudun Tu attacked Harachan, Baitai Taiji, Bushitu, and their tribes and defeated them all. He then pressed his advantage and invaded the Xuan-Datong frontier. That autumn the emperor held court on the review platform and summoned grand secretary Wang Xiangqian to ask his strategy. Xiangqian replied: "The way to counter the Cha Han is to set them against one another. Bushitu has fled west into the Ordos loop. Baitai Taiji escaped only by his own exertions. Harachan's followers have been largely captured and are of little use. Yong Shaobu is the strongest, with some three hundred thousand followers. Together with Bushitu's tribes, allied to the thirty-six Duoyan clans and Harachan's survivors, they could hold Cha Han at bay. Yet rather than pit them against each other, it would be better to win them over and put them to use. " The emperor said, "Cha Han has no intention of accepting pacification. What then? " He answered, "We should win them over patiently, by degrees. " The emperor asked, "And if they refuse to submit? " Xiangqian then submitted a secret memorial. The emperor approved and ordered him to go consult with supreme commander Yuan Chonghuan. Xiangqian reached the frontier and met with Chonghuan. Both agreed that pacifying the west would quiet the east—but with Hudun Tu refusing to submit and pressure mounting on both fronts, they settled on an annual payment of eighty-one thousand taels to the Cha Han to keep him in check. Datong grand coordinator Zhang Zongheng wrote: "The Cha Han came to Xuan-Datong and encamped at New City, only two hundred li from Datong. Three months have passed and they still dare not advance—they are starving and destitute. They are no stronger than we are. The Cha Han lives on pacification payments. Two years without receiving them have exhausted their resources. Their food is gone, their horses spent, and bleached bones litter the wilderness. The Cha Han's longing to submit is as desperate as a farmer's prayer for rain, yet we have sent them endless gold, silk, cattle, sheep, tea, fruit, rice, and grain—playing straight into their hands. The Cha Han is savage, arrogant, and insolent beyond what eyes can witness or ears endure—yet even as he begs to submit he behaves this way. If we feed and arm the Cha Han's forces, how much worse will his predatory rampages become? " Xiangqian replied: "The pacification is nearly settled. To unravel it now would show the Cha Han we cannot be trusted—and that is no way to serve the state. " When the memorial arrived the emperor sided with Xiangqian and ordered Zongheng to offer no further dissent.
94
明年秋，虎復擁眾至延綏紅水灘，乞增賞未遂，即縱掠塞外，總兵吳自勉御卻之。 既而東附大清兵攻龍門。 未幾，為大清兵所擊。 六年夏，插漢聞大清兵至，盡驅部眾渡河遠遁。 是時，韃靼諸部先後歸附於大清。 明年，大清兵遂大會諸部於兀蘇河南岡，頒軍律焉。 而虎已卒，乃追至上都城，盡俘插漢妻孥部眾。
The following autumn Hudun Tu again led his followers to Hongshuitan in Yansui. When his demand for increased rewards was denied he immediately raided beyond the frontier. Regional commander Wu Zimian drove him back. Before long he threw in his lot with the Great Qing and joined their attack on Longmen. Before long he was defeated by the Great Qing army. In the summer of the sixth year, Chakhar, learning that the Great Qing army was approaching, drove his entire following across the river and fled deep into the steppe. By then the Tartar tribes were submitting to the Great Qing one after another. The following year the Great Qing army gathered the allied tribes on the south bank of the Usu River and issued them a code of military discipline. Hu had already died by then. The Qing forces pursued as far as Shangdu and took captive Chakhar's wives, children, and entire following.
95
其後，套部歲入寧夏、甘、涼境，巡撫陳奇瑜、總兵馬世龍、督師洪承疇等輒擊敗之。 套部乾兒罵，亦為總兵尤世祿所斬。 迄明世，邊陲無寧，致中原盜賊蜂起。 當事者狃與俺答等貢市之便，見插之恣於東也，謂歲捐金錢數十萬，冀苟安旦夕，且覬收之為用，而卒不得。 迨其後也，明未亡而插先斃，諸部皆折入於大清。 國計愈困，邊事愈棘，朝議愈紛，明亦遂不可為矣。
Thereafter the Ordos Mongols raided into Ningxia, Ganzhou, and Liangzhou year after year, and each time Grand Coordinator Chen Qiyu, Regional Commander Ma Shilong, Supreme Commander Hong Chengchou, and others drove them back. Gan'erma of the Ordos was also killed by Regional Commander You Shilu. Throughout the Ming dynasty the frontier never knew peace, and in time bandit armies swarmed across the Central Plains. Officials had grown accustomed to the ease of tribute markets with Altan and his like. When they saw Chakhar running unchecked in the east, they imagined that by paying out several hundred thousand taels each year they could buy a night's peace and perhaps even enlist him on their side—but in the end they achieved neither. In time Chakhar died before the Ming dynasty itself fell, and one by one the tribes turned to the Great Qing. State finances grew tighter, frontier crises multiplied, and court debate grew ever more fractious. The Ming dynasty had reached the point of no return.
96
韃靼地，東至兀良哈，西至瓦剌。 當洪、永、宣世，國家全盛，頗受戎索，然畔服亦靡常。 正統後，邊備廢弛，聲靈不振。 諸部長多以雄傑之姿，恃其暴強，迭出與中夏抗。 邊境之禍，遂與明終始雲。
Tartar lands stretched east to Uriankhai and west to the Oirat confederation. In the Hongwu, Yongle, and Xuande reigns the dynasty stood at its zenith and largely kept the steppe peoples in hand, yet their loyalty and defiance were never stable for long. After the Zhengtong era frontier defenses decayed and the dynasty's authority on the border steadily waned. Tribal leaders—many of them formidable men in their own right—relied on raw military power and rose one after another to challenge the Central Plains. Frontier disaster, in short, shadowed the Ming dynasty from first to last.
